guides.facebook:
1. Iya ku-akhawunti yakho ye-Meta Business / Developers.
2. Dala i-Page Access Token enemvume ye-pages_manage_posts.
3. Kopisha i-Page ID yakho (ku-About/Settings yekhasi) ne-token ngezansi.
guides.x:
1. Iya ku-developer.x.com bese uvula i-app yakho.
2. Dala i-OAuth 2.0 user access token ene-scope ye-tweet.write.
3. Namathisela i-token ngezansi.
guides.linkedin:
1. Iya ku-linkedin.com/developers bese uvula i-app yakho.
2. Thola i-access token ene-scope ye-w_member_social.
3. Namathisela i-author URN yakho (urn:li:person:XXXX) ne-token ngezansi.
guides.instagram:
1. I-Instagram yakho kufanele ibe i-Business account exhunywe ku-Facebook Page.
2. Thola i-token enemvume ye-instagram_content_publish.
3. Namathisela i-Instagram user ID yakho ne-token ngezansi.
guides.whatsapp:
1. Setha i-WhatsApp Cloud API ku-Meta.
2. Kopisha i-access token yakho ehlala njalo.
3. Namathisela inombolo yocingo yomamukeli (nekhodi yezwe) ne-token ngezansi.

ext_hint.instagram: I-Instagram Business account user ID yakho
ext_hint.whatsapp: Inombolo yocingo yomamukeli enekhodi yezwe, e.g. 27821234567

Kufanele afane ngonobumba ngamunye — ngaphandle komugqa osekugcineni, ngaphandle kwe-www.

report_sources.work: Kusuka ekhasini lomsebenzi lephrojekthi ngayinye, lapho kwakhiwa khona isakhiwo nemisebenzi yaso.
report_sources.dependencies: Kusuka ku-Umsebenzi → Xhuma imisebenzi, lapho umsebenzi owodwa wenziwa ulinde omunye.
report_sources.schedule: Kubalwa isihleli kusuka kubude bemisebenzi nokuxhumana kwayo. Kusebenzise ekhasini leShejuli lephrojekthi.
report_sources.baseline: Kuqhathanisa namuhla nomugqa oyisisekelo ogciniwe. Gcina omunye ekhasini leShejuli lephrojekthi.
report_sources.recurrence: Kusuka emthethweni wokuphindaphinda ngaphakathi komsebenzi, ekhasini lomsebenzi.
report_sources.evidence: Kusuka kurejista yobufakazi — uhlelo lwasensimini, abathumeli bamamojula ne-API yokungenisa.
report_sources.figures: Kususelwa kubufakazi. Bheka ikhasi lezibalo lephrojekthi ukuze uthole imithetho engemuva kwenani ngalinye.
report_sources.timesheets: Kusuka ku-Ukulethwa → Isikhathi kuphrojekthi. Engeza abantu kuqala kuthebhu yabantu — amahora abhaliswa ngelungu.
report_sources.assignments: Kusuka ku-Umsebenzi, ngokwabela ilungu umsebenzi, ngephesenti lokwabiwa. Engeza abantu kuqala ku-Ukulethwa → Abantu.
report_sources.labour: Amahora agunyaziwe × isilinganiso. Beka isilinganiso lapho ubhalisa amahora ku-Ukulethwa → Isikhathi; kubalwa amahora agunyaziwe kuphela.
report_sources.costs: Kusuka ku-Ukulethwa → Izindleko kuphrojekthi, lapho kurekhodwa khona izinto, imishini nabaqashi abangaphansi. Kubalwa kuphela okuvunyiwe nokukhokhiwe.
report_sources.approvals: Kudalwa ngokuzenzakalelayo lapho amahora noma izindleko kuthunyelwa. Ukuthi ubani onquma kusethwa ku-Ukusetha → Indlela yokugunyaza.
report_sources.links: Kusuka ekhasini lephrojekthi, ngokuxhuma irekhodi kwenye imojula — impahla, i-oda lokuthenga, inkontileka.
report_sources.registers: Kubhalwe ohlwini lwephrojekthi lobungozi, izinkinga nezinguquko

capabilities.contracts_register: Xhuma iphrojekthi enkontilekeni elethwa ngaphansi kwayo
capabilities.hr_attendance: Funda ukuya emsebenzini lapho uhlola ukuthi ubani obekhona esizeni
capabilities.hr_employees: Engeza abasebenzi kuphrojekthi kusuka ohlwini lwe-HR
capabilities.hr_labour_rates: Bala amahora agunyaziwe ngesilinganiso sangempela somuntu ngamunye
capabilities.hr_leave: Xwayisa ngaphambi kokwabela umsebenzi umuntu osekhefini
capabilities.lms_competencies: Hlola ukuthi lowo owabelwe ufanelekile yini emsebenzini

links.title: Amarekhodi axhunyiwe
links.subtitle: Izinto ezikwamanye amamojula ezingezalo msebenzi
links.orphaned: Akusekho kumojula yomthombo — igama yilelo elarekhodwa ngesikhathi kuxhunywa.
links.confirm_remove_body: U-“{label}” akasavele kule phrojekthi. Irekhodi uqobo alithintwa.

site.title: Isayithi
site.subtitle: Okwenzekile, okulinganisiwe, okungahambi kahle kukho, nokukweletwayo
site.diary_sub: Umbhalo isicelo sokubambezeleka esiphikiswa ngaso — asisizi lutho ngaphandle uma sabhalwa ngalolo suku
site.no_diary_hint: Idayari yesayithi ingumbhalo wokuqala umuntu awufunayo lapho kuphikiswana ngokubambezeleka.
site.delays_hint: Noma yini emise noma eyehlise umsebenzi. Lobu ubufakazi obungemuva kokwelulwa kwesikhathi.
site.snags_sub: Izinto ezisohlwini lokulungisa, amaphutha nokungahambisani nemigomo
site.close_needs_evidence: Ukungahambisani nemigomo noma iphutha elibucayi kumele kusho ukuthi kulungiswe kanjani — uhla olugcwele ukuvalwa okungenalutho aluvikeleki ekudluliselweni komsebenzi.
site.kind_hint: Iphutha lincane ngokubukeka; i-NCR iwukwehluleka okusemthethweni kwekhwalithi okumele kuvalwe ngobufakazi.
site.boq_sub: Umsebenzi wanikwa liphi inani, nokuthi kulinganiswe kanjani ngokumelene nalo
site.measure_hint: Okuhlanganisiwe, hhayi okwalesi sikhathi. Uhla lwenzelwe {quantity} {unit}.
site.claims_sub: Umsebenzi olinganisiwe kuze kube manje, kususwe imali ebanjiwe, kususwe osekuqinisekisiwe
site.draft_claim_sub: Zonke izibalo zenziwa kusukela ohlwini nakwisitifiketi sokugcina — shintsha kuphela lokho okumele ukushintshe.
site.no_claims_hint: Linganisa uhla kuqala; isicelo silungiswa kusukela kulo.
site.confirm_certify_body: Isicelo #{number} se-{amount} siba yimali ekweletwayo, futhi sibhalwa ezindlekweni zephrojekthi. Lokhu akunakuhlehliswa.
site.retention_hint: Imvamisa ingu-10%, yehle ibe yingxenye lapho umsebenzi usuqedwe ngokwenza.
site.milestone_claim_hint: Okwezivumelwano ezikhokha ngezigaba kunokukhokha ngokulinganisa kuphela.
site.retention_note: Ikhululwa lapho umsebenzi usuqedwe ngokwenza nangokugcina

resources.title: Amagumbi, amalayisense nemishini
resources.subtitle: Izinto iphrojekthi eyizibhukhayo okungekho enye imojula egcina uhla lwazo. Impahla nezimoto zihlala kumamojula azo futhi zixhunywe kusukela ephrojekthini.
resources.confirm_remove_named: {name} ngeke isanikezwa. Amaphrojekthi asayisebenzisayo agcina irekhodi lawo.
resources.name: Igama

purchases.note: Lokhu kudala isicelo sokuthenga kuMnyango Wokuthenga, sinophawu lwekhodi yale phrojekthi. Ukuhlolwa kwabo kwesabelomali nochungechunge lwemvume kuyasebenza — akukho okuyalwayo ngaphambi kokuba bavume.
purchases.justification_hint: Kungani iphrojekthi ikudinga. Yilokhu ovumayo akufunda kuqala.
purchases.unavailable: Ukuthenga kwenziwa kwimojula Yokuthenga, engafakiwe kule ndawo yokusebenza.

announcements.title: Izaziso
announcements.subtitle: Ukutshela lonke ithimba lephrojekthi okuthile, ngerekhodi lokuthi ubani okubonile.
announcements.audience_hint: Iphrojekthi eyodwa, noma wonke umuntu owenza umsebenzi wephrojekthi.
announcements.urgent_warning: Izaziso eziphuthumayo zithunyelwa nange-SMS kuwo wonke umuntu ophrojekthini, futhi zibalwa esabelweni sakho se-SMS sanyanga zonke.
announcements.expires_hint: Shiya kungenalutho ukuze sihlale kuze kube uyasisusa.
announcements.require_ack_hint: Sebenzisa lokhu kunoma yini enomthelela wokuphepha noma wesivumelwano — hhayi ezazisweni ezijwayelekile.
announcements.ack_pending_body: Kukhona odinga ukwazi ukuthi ukufundile lokhu.
announcements.mail_ack_required: Sicela uvule isaziso uqinisekise ukuthi usifundile.

registers.title: Ubungozi, izinkinga nezinguquko
registers.subtitle: Okungase kungahambi kahle, okungahambanga kahle, nokuceliwe ukuthi kushintshe.
registers.changes_sub: Izicelo zokushintsha uhlelo lokuqala, nomthelela wazo oshiwo ngaphambi kwesinqumo
registers.change_sub: Sho umthelela ngaphambi kokuba kunqunywe — yilokho okwenza isinqumo sibe nencazelo.
registers.no_risks_hint: Iphrojekthi engenabungozi obubhaliwe akuyona iphrojekthi engenabungozi.
registers.no_changes_hint: Ukushintsha uhlelo ngaphandle kwaso akushiyi lutho lokuqhathanisa umehluko nalo.
registers.strategy_hint: Ukugwema kususa imbangela; ukudlulisela kudlulisela komunye umuntu, imvamisa ngesivumelwano noma ngomshwalense.
registers.kind_hint: Isigameko kumele sibhale imbangela yaso yangempela ngaphambi kokuba sivalwe.
registers.mitigation_hint: Isinyathelo esithathwa manje ukuze kwehle amathuba noma ubukhulu bakho.
registers.contingency_hint: Uhlelo ophindela kulo. Ukulubhala manje kushibhile kunokulubhala ngesikhathi kwenzeka.
registers.closure_hint: Sebuhambile, sebulawuliwe, noma sebamukelwe — sho ukuthi yikuphi.
registers.root_cause_required: Lesi yisigameko noma inkinga ebucayi, ngakho kumele kubhalwe imbangela yangempela ngaphambi kokuvalwa.
registers.impact_note: Sho ukuthi lokhu kwenzani ebubanzini, ezindlekweni, esikhathini nasekhwalithi. Shiya inkambu ingenalutho uma ungazi ngempela — u-0 ongawuqondi wehlisa ubukhulu boshintsho ngqo ngesikhathi othile ekuvuma.
registers.realise_note: Ubungozi buhlala ohlwini njengobenzekile, futhi inkinga entsha ikhomba emuva kubo — lolo xhumano ngubufakazi bokuthi kwakukhona owabubona buza.
registers.confirm_submit_body: {code} iya kunoma ubani ovuma izinguquko kule phrojekthi. Ngeke ukwazi ukuyihlela ngenkathi isekubo.
registers.confirm_implement_body: {code} iyasetshenziswa futhi kuthathwe uhlelo lokuqala, ukuze umthelela wayo eshejulini uhlale ulinganiseka ngemuva kwalokho.
registers.needs_root_cause: Isigameko noma inkinga ebucayi kumele kubhale imbangela yangempela.
registers.no_flow_auto: Alukho uchungechunge lokuvuma olwakhelwe izicelo zoshintsho kule ndawo yokusebenza, ngakho lubhalwe njengoluvunyiwe.

portfolio.title: Iphothifoliyo
portfolio.subtitle: Izinhlelo namaphrojekthi, nalokho abakusebenzisayo.
portfolio.portfolio_hint: Iqoqo lezinhlelo namaphrojekthi ancintisana ngemali efanayo.
portfolio.programme_hint: Iqoqo lamaphrojekthi aletha umphumela owodwa ndawonye.
portfolio.empty_body: Uhlelo yiqoqo lamaphrojekthi aletha umphumela owodwa — isibhedlela: isakhiwo, i-IT nabasebenzi. Iphothifoliyo yiqoqo lezinhlelo namaphrojekthi ancintisana ngemali efanayo. Kokubili akuphoqelekile: uma usebenza imisebenzi engahlobene, awudingi noma kukuphi.
portfolio.unassigned_sub: Kuboniswa ukuze isamba esingenhla singawaphuthi buthule.
portfolio.budget_hint: Okungasetshenziswa yile phothifoliyo. Ngaphandle kwakho akukho okuqhathaniswa nakho.
portfolio.outcome_hint: Umusho owodwa. Uhlelo olungenamphumela owodwa yiphothifoliyo ngelinye igama.
portfolio.assign_note: Iphrojekthi esohlelweni ithatha iphothifoliyo yalolo hlelo ngokuzenzakalela — izimpendulo ezimbili ku-“yiphi iphothifoliyo” yindlela isamba esiyeka ngayo ukuhlangana.

templates.title: Amathempulethi ephrojekthi
templates.subtitle: Lapho iphrojekthi entsha ingaqala khona, ukuze izingxenye abantu abazikhohlwayo zibe khona kakade.
templates.capture_sub: Guqula umsebenzi ohambe kahle ube yindawo yokuqala yolandelayo.
templates.capture_note: Izinsuku zigcinwa njengezikhala kusukela ekuqaleni kwephrojekthi, hhayi njengezinsuku zekhalenda — ithempulethi elinezinsuku zangempela lilungile ngosuku elibhalwa ngalo futhi lingalungile zonke izinsuku ezilandelayo.
templates.none_hint: Thatha iphrojekthi ehambe kahle, bese elandelayo iqala kuyo.
templates.sub_type_hint: Izindlu, imigwaqo, i-ERP, umkhankaso — noma ngabe abantu bakubiza kanjani.
templates.confirm_remove_body: {name} ngeke lisanikezwa. Amaphrojekthi adalwe kulo awathintwa.
templates.confirm_hide_body: {name} lithempulethi elithunyelwe, ngakho lifihlwa esikhundleni sokususwa — ukususa kungabuya ekuthuthukisweni okulandelayo.
templates.start_from_sub: Le phrojekthi ayikabi nalo uhlelo, ngakho lungabekwa phezu kwayo.

gates.title: Amasango ezigaba
gates.subtitle: Okumele kube yiqiniso ngaphambi kokuba le phrojekthi iqhubeke.
gates.criteria_hint: Kubhalwe ngaphambi kwesinqumo, hhayi emuva kwaso.
gates.waiver_needs_reason: Isango elidedelwe kumele lisho ukuthi kungani. Ukweqa elilodwa ngaphandle kwesizathu yirekhodi elisuswa kancane kancane.
gates.none_hint: Ngaphandle kwelilodwa, isigaba yilebula umuntu ayishintshayo.

site_records.title: Amarekhodi esayithi
site_records.subtitle: Iziyalezo, ukuhlolwa, ukubukwa nokuqedwa — amaphepha isicelo esiphikiswa ngawo.
site_records.instructions_sub: Okwatshelwa wena ukukwenza, nini, futhi ngubani
site_records.completion_sub: Ngokwenza, ngezingxenye nangokugcina — izitifiketi ezikhulula imali ebanjiwe
site_records.unconverted_title: Iziyalezo ezingu-{count} ezaziwa njengoshintsho kodwa ezingakaze zenziwe zibe wushintsho
site_records.unconverted_body: Yilapha imali ilahleka khona ekugcineni kwe-akhawunti. Zenzeni zibe izinguquko, noma nisuse isicelo.
site_records.no_inspections_hint: Ukushiya okukodwa yikho okuguqula umsebenzi ophelile ube umsebenzi okumele uphinde uvulwe.
site_records.no_completion_hint: Ukuqedwa ngokwenza kuqala inkathi yamaphutha futhi imvamisa kukhulula uhhafu wemali ebanjiwe.
site_records.issued_by_hint: Unjiniyela noma ummeleli weklayenti — imvamisa akuyena umuntu one-akhawunti lapha.
site_records.variation_hint: Bhala umbono wakho manje, hhayi ezinyangeni ezizayo lapho i-akhawunti iphikiswa.
site_records.instruction_sub: Kufayelwe ngaphambi kokuba noma ubani avume ukuthi kuwushintsho yini — yilokho okuyinjongo yakho.
site_records.fail_raises_ncr: Ukuhlolwa okuhlulekile kwenza ukungahambisani nemigomo ngokuzenzakalela. Ukuthelwa okuvela kukho sekumbozwe kakade, ngakho lokhu akushiywa emqondweni womuntu.
site_records.requested_for_hint: Ukubukwa okufunwa namuhla ntambama akusona isaziso.
site_records.outstanding_hint: Uhlu olunamathiselwe esitifiketini. Ukuqedwa ngokwenza kukhishwa umsebenzi usasele — lokho kuvamile.
site_records.certify_sub: Lokhu kukhulula imali ebanjiwe futhi kuqala iwashi lamaphutha.
site_records.certify_note: Ukuqedwa ngokwenza kwenqatshiwe ngenkathi kunephutha elibucayi noma ukungahambisani nemigomo okuvuliwe ohlwini — ukuqinisekisa phezu kwakho kudela ithuba lokukulungisa.
site_records.completion_blocked: Kunamaphutha abucayi noma ukungahambisani nemigomo okuvuliwe okungu-{count}. Ukuqedwa ngokwenza akunakuqinisekiswa phezu kwakho.

meetings.title: Imihlangano
meetings.subtitle: I-ajenda, amaminithi, ukuthi ubani obekhona, nokumele kwenziwe ngakho.
meetings.project_hint: Izenzo zingaba imisebenzi kuphrojekthi kuphela, ngakho umhlangano ongenayo ugcina izenzo zawo emaminithi.
meetings.minutes_outstanding_title: Imihlangano engu-{count} ebibanjiwe kodwa amaminithi angasabalalisiwe
meetings.agenda_hint: Ithunyelwa ngaphambi komhlangano; iba isakhiwo samaminithi.
meetings.minutes_note: Ukuba khona kubhalwa namaminithi ngenhloso: “kwavunyelwana emhlanganweni wesayithi” kuyimpikiswano kuphela uma irekhodi lisho ukuthi ubani obekhona ukuvumelana nakho.
meetings.actions_note: Izenzo ziba imisebenzi kuphrojekthi — isenzo esiphila kuphela emaminithi yisenzo esingasetshenzwa muntu.
meetings.confirm_remove_body: “{title}” namaminithi awo kuyasuswa. Izenzo esezidaliwe zihlala njengemisebenzi.

agile.title: Ama-sprint nohlu olulindile
agile.subtitle: Izindaba yimisebenzi ejwayelekile, ngakho ibhodi, ishejuli namashidi esikhathi kusasebenza konke.
agile.backlog_sub: Izinto ezingahlelwanga zihlala ngaphansi — into engabekwanga phambili muntu akuyona ebaluleke kunazo zonke.
agile.epics_sub: Umsebenzi odlula ama-sprint. Inqubekelaphambili yizindaba zayo, hhayi isilinganiso esehlukene esingaphikisana nazo.
agile.no_active_hint: Hlela enye, faka izindaba kuyo, bese uyayiqalisa.
agile.no_goal: Alukho uhloso olubekiwe — i-sprint engenalo iyibhokisi lesikhathi nje.
agile.goal_hint: Umusho owodwa. Uma ungakwazi ukuwubhala, i-sprint ayinalo uhloso.
agile.revision_hint: Ngaphandle kwayo, “kwakukhona kuphi kule nguqulo” kuyoba yisiqagelo ezinyangeni eziyisithupha ezizayo.
agile.close_note: Izindaba ezingaqediwe zibuyela ohlwini olulindile, hhayi phambili ku-sprint elandelayo — ukuzidlulisela ngokuzenzakalela yindlela i-sprint elandelayo eqala ngayo igcwele ngaphambi kokuba noma ubani ayihlele.
agile.one_at_a_time: Enye i-sprint isivele iqhubeka kule phrojekthi. Ezimbili kanyekanye zenza isivinini negrafu yokusha kungacaci.

portal.title: Amaphrojekthi akho
portal.subtitle: Okwenzekayo emisebenzini yakho, nokudinga wena.
portal.empty_body: Le khasi likhombisa amaphrojekthi oxhunywe kuwo njengeklayenti noma njengokhonteka. Uma usebenza lapha, amaphrojekthi akho angaphansi kwe-Amaphrojekthi.
portal.progress_note: Leli yinani elifanayo elibonwa ithimba elilethayo — alibalwa ngokwehlukile kuwe.
portal.time_sub: Kudlula kumvume efanayo neyeshidi lesikhathi lomunye wonke.
portal.documents_sub: Konke kulo msebenzi ongakubona, nendawo yokusithumelela okuthile
portal.rate_sub: Isilinganiso esisodwa ngenyanga — siya ngqo ethimbeni elilethayo.
portal.rate_dialog_sub: Ukuthembeka kusiza kunomusa. Akekho olinganiswa ngalokhu ngamunye.
portal.my_invoices_sub: Lungisa isikweletu somsebenzi wakho bese usithumela kumphathi wephrojekthi.
portal.cinvoice_empty: Engeza okungenani umugqa owodwa, noma namathisela isikweletu sakho, ngaphambi kokusithumela.
portal.cinvoice_sent: Lesi sikweletu sesithunyelwe futhi ngeke sisashintshwa.
portal.my_contracts_sub: Lokho osebenza ngaphansi kwakho kulo msebenzi.
portal.raise_request_sub: Kuya ngqo kubantu abaqhuba le phrojekthi.

assistant.title: Umsizi
assistant.subtitle: Okushiwo yidatha ukuthi kudinga ukunakwa, nosizo ngokubhala.
assistant.all_clear_hint: Yonke iphrojekthi esebenzayo iyabika, ingaphakathi kwezinkomba zayo, futhi ayinazo izinqumo ezibambekile.
assistant.draft_sub: Izibalo zithathwa ephrojekthini; imodeli ibhala amagama azungezile kuphela.
assistant.draft_warning: Uhlaka. Wufunde ngaphambi kokuwuthumela — izibalo zingezempela, imisho ayikabi ngeyakho.
assistant.no_provider: Akukho mhlinzeki we-AI olungiselelwe kule ndawo yokusebenza, ngakho ukubhala akutholakali. Konke okungenhla kubalwa kusuka kudatha yakho futhi akudingi omunye.
assistant.slipping_detail: {name} izuze u-{spi} wenani ebihlose ukulizuza manje.
assistant.overloaded_detail: Amahora angu-{hours} ahleliwe enyangeni yamahora angu-{capacity}, kumaphrojekthi angu-{projects}.
assistant.silent_title: Amaphrojekthi asebenzayo angu-{count} awabikanga lutho amasonto amabili
assistant.silent_detail: Iphrojekthi engabiki lutho akuyona iphrojekthi ehamba kahle — yileyo okungekho muntu ongasho lutho ngayo.
assistant.risk_title: Ubungozi obukhulu obungu-{count} obungenalo ukunciphisa okubhaliwe
assistant.risk_detail: Bunamaphuzu angu-15 noma ngaphezulu, futhi akukho okubhaliwe ngalokho okwenziwayo.
assistant.change_title: Izicelo zoshintsho ezingu-{count} ezilinde ngaphezu kwesonto
assistant.change_detail: Zithunyelwe futhi zisangaqedwa. Uhlelo nesinqumo kuyahlukana.

alerts.deadline_title: Imisebenzi engu-{count} ephelelwa yisikhathi ezinsukwini ezingu-{days} ezizayo
alerts.overdue_detail: Isavuliwe, futhi izinsuku ezisohlelweni azisasho lutho.

equipment.title: Ukuhlolwa kwemishini
equipment.sub: Ukuhlolwa ngaphambi kokusetshenziswa — inani yiyo yonke inqubo engaphazamisekile, hhayi okukodwa
equipment.identifier_hint: Iskene noma uyithayiphe. Ikhodi engahambisani nalutho olusefayeleni isakufanele ukubhalwa.
equipment.signed_hint: Igama lakho, isikhathi nekheli lakho kuyabhalwa — okufana nokusayina umbhalo.

contractors.title: Ama-invoyisi osonkontileka
contractors.subtitle: Lokho osonkontileka abakuthumele ngomsebenzi wamaphrojekthi akho.
contractors.markup_hint: Akuphoqiwe, futhi ayikaze iboniswe iklayenti noma usonkontileka. Shiya kungenalutho uma ingekho.
contractors.reject_sub: Usonkontileka uboniswa isizathu sakho, ngakho bhala into angathatha isinyathelo ngayo.
contractors.no_email: Lo sonkontileka akanalo ikheli le-imeyili, ngakho inkontileka ayikwazi ukuthunyelwa.
contractors.not_submitted: Kuphela i-invoyisi ethunyelwe engavunywa noma yenqatshwe.
contractors.register_sub: Wonke umuntu owenza naye inkontileka, nakho konke ngaye.
contractors.add_sub: Igama labo nokuthi ungabathola kanjani. Banikeze iphrojekthi bese bethola ukufinyelela kuphothali ukuze bakukhokhise.
contractors.from_suppliers: Lezi izinkomba zakho zabahlinzeki. Ukungeza omunye lapha kumfaka naku-Supplier Management.
contractors.field_email_hint: Lapho isimemo sabo sephothali siya khona.
contractors.on_projects: amaphrojekthi angu-{count} | iphrojekthi engu-{count} | amaphrojekthi angu-{count}
contractors.our_signatory_hint: Batshelwa ku-app, futhi inkontileka ilinde isiginesha yabo lapha.

contracts.title: Izinkontileka
contracts.subtitle: Izinkontileka zephrojekthi — zilotshwa, zichitshiyelwe, zibuyekezwe futhi zisayinwe lapha.
contracts.draft_sub: Qala kwesinye sezifanekiso zakho, noma ungaqali lutho.
contracts.template_hint: Izifanekiso zephrojekthi zakho. Shiya kungenalutho ukuze uzibhalele imibandela.
contracts.title_hint: Shiya kungenalutho ukuze iqanjwe ngokosonkontileka nephrojekthi.

contracts.signature_stale: Kusayinwe kunguqulo yangaphambili. Amagama ashintshile kusukela lapho.
contracts.type_your_name_hint: Ukuthayipha igama lakho lapha kuyisiginesha yakho.
contracts.decline_reason_hint: Elinye iqembu liyakubona lokhu, futhi kufanele likwazi ukuthatha isinyathelo.
contracts.send_explainer: {contractor} usayina kuqala, bese umuntu omkhethayo ngezansi esayina naye.
contracts.closed: Inkontileka esayiniwe noma ekhanseliwe ayisakwazi ukushintshwa.
contracts.not_submittable: Kuphela uhlaka noma inkontileka enqatshiwe engathunyelwa ukuze ibuyekezwe.
contracts.not_sendable: Kuphela inkontileka evunyiwe noma euhlaka engathunyelwa ukuze isayinwe.
contracts.no_counterparty: Le nkontileka ayinaye usonkontileka, ngakho ayikwazi ukuthunyelwa.
contracts.already_decided: Le siginesha isivele inikeziwe noma yenqatshiwe.
contracts.no_signatory_email: Umsayini okhethiwe akanalo ikheli le-imeyili, ngakho inkontileka ayikwazi ukuthunyelwa.
contracts.member_hint: Ukuthi inkontileka ingubani. Kudingeka ngaphambi kokuba ithunyelwe ukuze isayinwe.
contracts.no_contractors_on_project: Abekho osonkontileka kule phrojekthi — engeza omunye kuqala esikrinini sabaqashi abancane.
contracts.name_alongside_drawing: Your name in text as well, so the record stays legible.
contracts.reopen_reason_hint: Every party who signed is told this.
contracts.reopen_warning: This contract is signed. Reopening tells everybody who signed, returns it to draft, and it must be signed again.
contracts.not_reopenable: Only a signed contract can be reopened.
contracts.reopen_reason_required: Say why the contract is being reopened.
contracts.not_yours_to_amend: This contract is not yours to change.
contracts.bad_signature_image: That signature could not be read.
contracts.signature_too_large: That signature image is too large.
contracts.mail_reopened_line: Contract {number} on {project} has been reopened for amendment.
contracts.mail_reopened_resign: The wording will change, so it will come back to you to sign again.
contracts.inapp_reopened: Contract {number} has been reopened for amendment.
contracts.need_drawing: Draw your signature above, or switch to Type.
contracts.no_document: Akukho dokhumenti elikhiqiziwe kwale nkontileka okwamanje.
contracts.bad_signed_pdf: Lelo dokhumenti elisayiniwe alikwazanga ukufundwa njenge-PDF.
contracts.amendment_would_drop_tables: Lolu shintsho luzosusa amathebula angu-{n} enkontilekeni — umhleli akakwazi ukuwagcina. Hlela amagama kwenye indawo, noma ucele ukuthi ithebula lishintshwe kusifanekiso.
contracts.sign_steps: Khetha noma dweba isiginesha, chofoza lapho kufanele ibe sekhasini, bese usayina.
contracts.need_a_signature: Khetha isiginesha elondolozwe, noma dweba eyodwa.
contracts.place_it_on_the_page: Chofoza ekhasini lapho isiginesha yakho kufanele ibe.
contracts.signing_failed: Inkontileka ayikwazanga ukusayinwa. Sicela uzame futhi.
contracts.counterparty_has_no_login: Lo sonkontileka akanakho ukungena okwamanje, ngakho ubengeke akwazi ukusayina. Memela yena kuphothali kuqala.
contracts.signatory_cannot_sign: Leli qembu alinakho ukungena, ngakho ngeke likwazi ukusayina. Limemele kuphothali, bese uthumela inkontileka futhi.

contract_templates.title: Izifanekiso zezinkontileka

contract_templates.import_is_a_copy: Ukungenisa kuthatha ikhophi. Ukuyihlela lapha akulokothi kushintshe eyokuqala, futhi ihlala ingeyakho uma i-Contract Management isusiwe.

steps.needs_done: Isinyathelo esisodwa kumele sibalwe njengeQediwe, ngaphandle kwalokho akukho lutho kuleli bhodi olungaqedwa.
steps.will_move: Imisebenzi engu-{count} ikusinyathelo osisusile. Izodluliselwa ekholomu yokuqala.
steps.too_many: Ibhodi likhawulelwe kumakholomu angu-{max}; ngaphezu kwalokho akekho ongalifunda.
steps.bad_category: U-“{label}” kumele abalwe njengesinye sezimo ezakhelwe ngaphakathi.

data_sources.title: Imithombo yedatha
data_sources.subtitle: Imithombo le nkampani eqinisekisa ngayo abahlinzeki, lokho umthombo ngamunye ongakuphendula, nokuhlolwa okungakaze kuphendulwe muntu.
data_sources.ledger_broken: Uchungechunge lobufakazi aluvumelani kurekhodi {at} ({reason}). Phatha ubufakazi obuthintekayo njengobungaqinisekisiwe kuze kuphenywe.
data_sources.coverage_help: Konke ukuhlolwa le module eyaziyo ukukwenza, nokuthi ngubani okuphendulayo namuhla. Ukuhlolwa okungenamthombo akweqiwa — kuqoshwa njengokungatholakali kuze kube khona umuntu okwenzayo aqophe akutholile.
data_sources.manual_notice: Ukuhlolwa okungu-{count} akunamthombo olungisiwe, ngakho umuntu kufanele akwenze aqophe akutholile.
data_sources.enable_help: Uma lokhu kuvaliwe, ukuhlolwa obekungaphendulwa ngukho kuqoshwa njengokungatholakali kunokuba kuphase.
data_sources.credentials_help: Kubethelwe lapho kugcinwe khona futhi akulokothi kubuyiselwe kulesi sikrini. Faka ukhiye ukuze umshintshe; okhiye ongabaphindi ubathayiphe bayagcinwa.
data_sources.default_for_help: Lapho imithombo engaphezu kweyodwa ingaphendula ukuhlolwa, lo ubuzwa kuqala.
data_sources.monthly_quota_help: Imithombo ekhokhelwayo ibiza imali ngocingo ngalunye. Uma isabelo sesiphelile, ukuhlolwa kuqoshwa njengokungatholakali esikhundleni sokukukhokhisa.
data_sources.endpoints_help: Ikheli i-akhawunti yakho egunyaziwe elinikeza ukuhlolwa ngakunye. Izindawo zokugcwalisa zigcwaliswa kusuka kumhlinzeki.
data_sources.endpoint_hint: Izindawo zokugcwalisa: registration_number, company_name, vat_number, tax_reference_number, account_number, reference
data_sources.manual_provider_note: Kuhlala kutholakala. Umuntu wenza ukuhlolwa emthonjeni aqophe akutholile — kungena kulo lolu hlu lwezibonelo, nobufakazi obufanayo, kubhalwe egameni lakhe.
data_sources.profiled: Ukuhlola okungu-{count} sekwazi ukuthi kushayele kuphi. Faka imininingwane yakho yokungena futhi kuzosebenza — izinkambu ezingezansi zezinkontileka ezihlukile kuphela.

verifications.title: Ukucwaninga ngokucophelela
verifications.outstanding: Ukuhlolwa okungu-{count} kusadinga ukunakwa ngaphambi kokuba lo mhlinzeki athathwe njengoqinisekisiwe.
verifications.record_help: Kokuhlolwa okwenze wena emthonjeni. Kugcinwa nobufakazi obufanayo nalokho okwenziwe umshini, kubhalwe egameni lakho — ukuze kungabi khona ozokuthatha njengempendulo eqinisekiswe ngumshini.
verifications.observed_help: Thayipha lokho umthombo okuveze ngempela. Kuqhathaniswa nalokho umhlinzeki asitshele khona, insimu nensimu, ukuze umehluko utholakale kunokwamukelwa ngokwethemba.
verifications.pin_held: I-PIN ibanjelwe lo mhlinzeki, ngakho isimo sabo sokuthobela intela singaqinisekiswa.
verifications.pin_missing: Ayikho i-PIN okwamanje. I-PIN ye-TCS yomhlinzeki yimvume yabo yokuba uqinisekise isimo sabo sokuthobela intela.
verifications.pin_help: Igcinwe ibethelwe, isetshenziselwa kuphela ukuqinisekisa isimo sokuthobela intela. Ukuqinisekisa kuqopha lokho i-SARS ekushilo ngesikhathi kubuzwa — yingakho lokhu kungesona ukulayisha isitifiketi.

errors.no_source: Awukho umthombo olungiselelwe u-{check}, ngakho ngeke kusebenze ngokuzenzakalelayo. Qopha ukuhlolwa wena, noma ulungise umthombo ku-Lungisa → Imithombo yedatha.

ownership.title: Ubunikazi
ownership.no_ubos: Akukho muntu wemvelo osetholakele. Uma uchungechunge lungakafiki kubantu, akekho ongahlolwa — inkampani ayinakujeziswa futhi ayinakuba yi-PEP.
ownership.diagram_alt: Umdwebo wobunikazi. Ulwazi olufanayo lusethebulini elingezansi kwawo.
ownership.table_caption: Wonke amasabelo obunikazi aqoshiwe. Leli thebula yisithombe esigcwele — umdwebo ongenhla ukhombisa ubudlelwano obufanayo.
ownership.as_at_help: Usuku lapho lesi sabelo sasiyiqiniso ngalo. Irekhodi lobunikazi elingenalo usuku liyisimangalo esingaphathelene nesikhathi esithile.
ownership.unallocated: {entity}: u-{missing}% wamasheya awuchazwanga. Ukhona owubambile ongakaqanjwa.
ownership.unstated_stakes: {entity}: amasabelo angu-{n} aqoshwe ngaphandle kobukhulu, ngakho amasheya ngeke acaciswe.
ownership.over_allocated: {entity}: amasabelo amenyezelwe afinyelela ku-{declared}%, okungaphezu kwenkampani yonke.
ownership.related_help: Abahlinzeki abanomuntu noma inkampani ebambile efanayo nalona. Ngokuvamile akunacala — futhi kuyindlela iqembu elilodwa elifaka ngayo itenda ngamagama amathathu.
ownership.owns_what_help: Umhlinzeki uqobo, noma inkampani ephakeme ochungechungeni.
ownership.compare_help: Faka abanikazi abazuzayo ngendlela irejista ebabhala ngayo. Baqhathaniswa nabantu uchungechunge lwalo mhlinzeki olufinyelela kubo — igebe phakathi kwalezi zinhlu yilona okutholakele.

risk.title: Ukuhlolwa kwengozi
risk.never_assessed: Lo mhlinzeki akakahlolwa. Kuze kwenzeke lokho, akukho lapha okusho ukuthi kuphephile yini ukuhwebelana nabo.
risk.trend_alt: Ukuthambekela kwamaphuzu engozi ekuhlolweni okungu-{n} kokugcina.
risk.gates_pass: Wonke amasango okugunyaza aphumelele. Lo mhlinzeki angagunyazwa ngaphandle kokubuyekezwa okwengeziwe.
risk.tier_unset: Alikamiswa — ubudlelwano yibo obunquma ukuthi kudingeka ukucwaninga okungakanani.
risk.tier_help: Phendula ngalobu budlelwano, hhayi ngenkampani ngokujwayelekile. Umhlinzeki ofanayo angaba izinga 1 kwezokubhala kanti abe izinga 4 ekuxhumaneni kweholo.
risk.record_hit_help: Kokuvumelana okuthole ohlwini olushicilelwe. Kubalwa ngokumelene nomhlinzeki futhi kuqashwe njengalokho okulandwe ngumshini.
risk.subject: Kuhloliwe
risk.reason_help: Kuyadingeka uma ususa okuvumelanayo. Ngonyaka ozayo, ukuchithwa okungachaziwe ngeke kwehlukaniswe nokucindezela ngephutha.

reputation.title: Idumela nokuqashwa kwezinkundla
reputation.no_source_notice: Awukho umthombo wezindaba noma wezinkundla olungisiwe, ngakho akukho okungaseshwa ngokuzenzakalelayo. Umhlinzeki obengeke aseshwe muntu akufanele athathwe njengalowo okungatholakalanga lutho ngaye.
reputation.no_coverage: Akukho okuseshiwe ngalo mhlinzeki okwamanje. Lokho akulona irekhodi elihlanzekile — kungukungabi khona kwalo.
reputation.needs_review_notice: Ukushiwo okungu-{n} akukwazanga ukuxhunywa kulo mhlinzeki ngokuqiniseka. Akubalwa kuze kube khona oqinisekisa ukuthi yinkampani efanele.
reputation.attributed: Siqiniseka ngo-{n}% ukuthi lokhu kumayelana nalo mhlinzeki
reputation.attribution_warning: Siqiniseka ngo-{n}% kuphela ukuthi lokhu kushiwo kumayelana nalo mhlinzeki. Qinisekisa ukuthi yinkampani efanele ngaphambi kokukuphatha njengokutholakele.
reputation.reason_help: Kuyadingeka uma ususa okutholakele. Ngonyaka ozayo, ukuchithwa okungachaziwe ngeke kwehlukaniswe nokucindezela ngephutha.
reputation.watching_help: Umhlinzeki akavamile ukubizwa ngegama elisefakthini yakhe. Amabhrendi, amagama okuhweba, amawebhusayithi nama-akhawunti ezinkundla konke kuyaseshwa, kanye nabaqondisi bamanje nabanikazi abazuzayo.
reputation.nothing_watched: Igama elibhalisiwe kuphela, igama lokuhweba nabantu bamanje.
reputation.watch_help: Engeza ibhrendi, iwebhusayithi noma i-akhawunti yenkundla. Ama-akhawunti ahlukene ngenkundla, ngoba igama elifanayo ezinkundleni ezimbili kungama-akhawunti amabili ahlukene.

passport.health_unknown: Kusenesikhathi ukusho. Akukho okucelwe kubo futhi akukho okulethiwe okwamanje.
passport.never_assessed: Akukaze kuhlolwe. Akukho lapha okusho ukuthi kuphephile yini ukuhwebelana nalo mhlinzeki.
passport.not_searched: Akuseshiwe. Lokho kungukungabi khona kwerekhodi, hhayi irekhodi elihlanzekile.
passport.needs_a_person: Awukho umthombo olungisiwe; umuntu kufanele akuhlole
passport.conditions_lapsed: Imibandela beyifanele ngo-{date} futhi ayifezekanga. Lokhu kugunyazwa akufanele kuthenjwe.
passport.no_ubos: Akukho muntu wemvelo otholakele. Uma uchungechunge lungakafiki kubantu, akekho ongahlolwa.
passport.moves_to: Kudlulisela icala ku-{state}. Lesi yisinqumo se-{slot}.
passport.conditions_due_help: Ukugunyazwa okunemibandela okungenamkhawulo wesikhathi kuwukugunyazwa nje.
passport.override_help: Ukudlulisa kuqoshwa ecaleni kanye nalokho obekungaphumelelanga ngaleso sikhathi.

monitoring.subtitle: Konke kubo bonke abahlinzeki okungakabukwa muntu — izinguquko emithonjeni, okutholakele emithonjeni yezindaba, nokuvumelana kokuhlolwa.
monitoring.due_help: Abahlinzeki abanokuhlolwa okuphelelwe yisikhathi. Lo ngumsebenzi okungekho oke waziswa ngawo — umbuzo ongaphendulwanga awupheli ukuba yisidingo ngokuziba wona.
monitoring.note_help: Kuyadingeka uma uchitha. Ngonyaka ozayo, ukuchithwa okungachaziwe ngeke kwehlukaniswe nokucindezela ngephutha.
monitoring.swept: Kuhlolwe ukuhlolwa okungu-{checks}; kutholakale izinguquko ezingu-{changes}.

monitoring.cases_help: Amacala okuhlola alinde umuntu. Asephelelwe yisikhathi kuqala.

packs.title: Amaphakethe Emithetho
packs.subtitle: Amabhuku emithetho ahlukanisa izigameko futhi abeke imihla yomthetho
packs.empty: Akukho phakethe lomthetho elifakwe kulesi sistimu. Kuze kube lifakwe futhi livulwe, izigameko azikwazi ukubikwa — buza umlawuli wesistimu ukuthi afake amaphakethe omthetho we-SHEQ.
packs.site_coverage: Yiliphi incwadi yemithetho elawula iyiphi indawo
packs.no_sites_hint: Azikho izindawo ezisebenzayo ezisethiwe, ngakho lokhu kungavulwa kuphela kuyo yonke inkampani.
packs.site_type_mismatch: Leli phakethe libhalelwe {types}. I-{sites} akuzona lezo zinhlobo — livule kuphela uma uqinisekile.
packs.preview_hint: Ukubuka kuqala yindawo yokulinga: akuyihlwanyeli irejista yomthetho futhi akudali izibopho zomthetho zangempela.
packs.supersede_hint: Ukuvula kuthatha indawo yalokho okusebenzayo ebubanzini obufanayo. Okwangaphambili kuyagcinwa, ngoba ukuthi yiliphi incwadi yemithetho ebisebenza nanini kungubufakazi.

legal.title: Irejista Yezomthetho
legal.subtitle: Izidingo zomthetho ezisuselwa emaphakethe emithetho asebenzayo
legal.needs_company: Khetha inkampani ukuze ubone irejista yayo yezomthetho.
legal.no_evidence: Akukho okuxhunyiwe okwamanje, ngakho lesi sidingo asikwazi ukuhlolwa.
legal.act_hint: Xhuma idokhumenti ekufakazelayo, bese ubhala ukuthi kufezwe nini; ukubuyekezwa okulandelayo kulandela imvamisa yesigatshana.

incident.potential_hint_high: Amandla aphezulu — lokhu kuzodinga uphenyo olugcwele
incident.incapacity_hint: Izinsuku ezingu-14 noma ngaphezulu kungenza lokhu kubikwe
incident.anonymous_hint: Ubunikazi bakho ngeke bugcinwe kule rekhodi
incident.classification_note: Uma kuthunyelwa lokhu kuhlukaniswa ngokwephakethe lakho lomthetho elisebenzayo, futhi noma yimiphi imihla yomthetho iqala ngokushesha.
incident.context_explainer: Kuthwetshulwe ngesikhathi kubikwa isigameko futhi kwamiswa — yilokho okwakuyiqiniso ngaleso sikhathi.
incident.no_gaps_detail: Akukho okuphawuliwe ngabantu, imishini noma indawo ebandakanyekile.

no_company.title: Ayikho inkampani esebenzayo
no_company.body: Amarekhodi e-SHEQ angawenkampani. Ungene njengomlawuli weplatifomu, ongaphezu kwanoma iyiphi inkampani eyodwa — khetha inkampani ofuna ukusebenza kuyo.
no_company.body_self_hosted: Ayikho inkampani esethiwe kule nhlanganiselo okwamanje. Amarekhodi e-SHEQ angawenkampani, ngakho dala eyodwa ngaphansi kweZilungiselelo ngaphambi kokusebenzisa le moduli.

hazard.report_subtitle: Okuthile okungaphephile okubonile — umugqa owodwa wanele
hazard.you_will_hear_back: Uzotshelwa ukuthi kwenzekani ngalo mbiko, kufaka phakathi uma ungaqhutshekiswa.
hazard.reason_hint: Umbiki utshelwa lokhu. Ukwenqaba ngaphandle kwesizathu kwenza abantu bayeke ukubika.
hazard.link_hint: Sebenzisa lokhu uma ingozi iphenduke yaba yisigameko. Ngaphandle kwalokho kuhlala kuyizinkomba ezimbili ezahlukene zomcimbi owodwa, futhi isigameko asiphethe mpawu yokuthi kukhona owayeyiphawulile ingozi ngaphambili.

action.title: Izenzo
action.subtitle: Uhlu olulodwa, noma yini eyikuqalile
action.extend_reason_hint: Kuqoshwe esenzweni futhi kwabalwa — ukunwetshwa kuyabonakala, akuthulile.
action.hierarchy_hint: Khetha ukususa noma ubunjiniyela kunokutshela abantu ukuthi baqaphele

risk.title: Ukuhlolwa Kwezingozi
risk.subtitle: Izingozi ezihloliwe, ukulawulwa kwazo nokuthi zibuyekezwa nini
risk.empty: Akukho ukuhlolwa kwezingozi. Kudingeka okukodwa ngaphambi kokuqala komsebenzi wokwakha.
risk.add_note: Idalwa njengesihlaka. Engeza imigqa yezingozi nokulawula, bese uyithumela ukuze igunyazwe.

permits.title: Izimvume Zokusebenza
permits.subtitle: Umsebenzi oyingozi ongaqali ngaphandle kwemvume ebhaliwe
permits.add_note: Imvume eceliwe ayisebenzi. Ayigunyazi lutho ize ikhishwe ngemva kokuhlolwa.

inspections.title: Ukuhlolwa
inspections.subtitle: Uhlelo okungamele lweqe isikhathi, nokuqediwe
inspections.schedules_hint: Uhlelo oludlulelwe yisikhathi ukulawula okuyekile ukusebenza
inspections.empty_schedules: Azikho izinhlelo zokuhlola. Akukho okuhlolwa ngokujwayelekile.

competency.title: Amakhono
competency.subtitle: Ubani ofanelekile noqokiwe ukwenza ini, nokuthi kuphela nini
competency.records_hint: Kuhlelwe ngokuphela — lolu rejista lukhombisa ophelelwa maduze
competency.add_note: Ichaza ukuthi ikhono liyini. Amarekhodi abantu ngabanye afakwa kulo futhi aphelelwa ngesikhathi osisethile.
competency.record_note: Iziqu ezitholakale kwenye indawo — isitifiketi sokusiza okuphuthumayo, ithikithi lokuphakamisa, ilayisensi. Shiya usuku lokuphela kungagcwalisiwe futhi isikhathi sokusebenza sekhono uqobo siyasimisa.
competency.expiry_hint: Okungagcwalisiwe kusho ukuthi isikhathi sokusebenza sekhono siyanquma.
competency.evidence_hint: Isitifiketi uqobo. Sigcinwa nerekhodi futhi singalandwa kulo.

documents.title: Amadokhumenti
documents.subtitle: Izinqubo ezilawulwayo: okushicilelwe nokudinga ukubuyekezwa
documents.add_note: Idalwa njengesihlaka nenguqulo 1. Isihlaka asibonakali kubafundi uze usishicilele.
documents.publish_note: Le nguqulo iba yileyo esebenzayo. Eyangaphambili iyashintshwa, futhi noma ubani owaqinisekisa umbhalo oshintshiwe kumele aqinisekise omusha.
documents.awaiting_publish_hint: Uhlaka yinqubo engalandelwa muntu: ayiveli emtatsheni wamadokhumenti futhi akekho ongacelwa ukuyiqinisekisa.

contractors.title: Osonkontileka
contractors.subtitle: Ubani ongaba khona endaweni, nokuvimba abanye
contractors.hint: Abavinjelwe kuqala — laba abantu okungamele babe khona
contractors.add_note: Usonkontileka omusha uvinjelwe kuze kube wonke amadokhumenti adingekayo akhona futhi asemthethweni.
contractors.from_supplier_hint: Ukukhetha umhlinzeki kugcwalisa lonke leli fomu kusuka kurekhodi lakhe futhi kuxhume ifayela lokuphepha nelezohwebo. Shiya kungenalutho kumnikontileka ongeyena umhlinzeki.
contractors.from_supplier_filled: Kugcwaliswe kusuka kurekhodi lomhlinzeki. Lokho obusukubhalile kushiywe njengoba ubukubhalile.

sites.title: Izindawo
sites.subtitle: Lapho umsebenzi wenzeka khona — wonke amarekhodi e-SHEQ axhomeke kulokhu
sites.mirrored: Izindawo zilandela Isakhiwo Senkampani yakho. Yengeza iyunithi lapho ivele lapha ebusuku.
sites.empty: Azikho izindawo. Sebenzisa ukuvumelanisa kwesakhiwo noma yengeza amayunithi.

registers.attach_hint: Hudula amafayela lapha, amaningi ngesikhathi esisodwa, noma i-zip eyodwa — i-zip iba idokhumenti elilawulwayo elilodwa ngefayela ngalinye elingaphakathi. Igcinwa kusizindalwazi, icindezelwe futhi ibethelwe uma ingasetshenziswa.

audience.hint: Inqubo yokuphepha engatholakali muntu ayivikeli muntu, ngakho wonke umuntu uyisimiso. Ukukhawulela kuwukuhlukile.

analysis.title: Ukuhlaziya kwe-BI
analysis.subtitle: Izinyanga eziyishumi nambili zokusebenza kokuphepha, kusukela kusibikezelo se-KPI
analysis.no_snapshots: Azikho izithombe ze-KPI — isibikezelo sakhiwa njalo ebusuku.
analysis.gaps: Izinyanga ezingu-{count} azinaso isithombe — kukhonjiswa njengegebe, hhayi njengeqanda.

reports.title: Imibiko ye-BI
reports.subtitle: Umbiko wenyanga wokuphepha, owakhiwe kulokho okukule module
reports.no_narrative: Izinombolo kuphela. Umbono obhaliwe udinga i-AI Safety Officer, engakakhiwa.

conflicts.title: Kudinga Ukunakwa Kwakho
conflicts.subtitle: Lapho idivayisi neseva zingavumelani. Womabili amagugu agcinwa — nquma wena.
conflicts.all_clear: Azikho izingxabano. Zonke izinguquko zedivayisi zisetshenzisiwe.
conflicts.rejected_operations: Imisebenzi yedivayisi engu-{count} yenqatshelwe futhi irekhodiwe.
conflicts.both_kept: Womabili amagugu ahlala erekhodini noma ngabe ukhetha kuphi.

forms.title: Amafomu Omthetho
forms.subtitle: Amafomu adingwa umlawuli, agcwaliswe kusengaphambili kusuka esigamekweni
forms.outstanding: Amafomu adingekayo angu-{count} awakakhiqizwa. Imikhawulo yomthetho iyasebenza.
forms.none_reportable: Azikho izigameko okufanele zibikwe. Akukho okukweletwayo umlawuli.
forms.gaps_hint: Akukho okuqagelwe. Gcwalisa ngayinye, uma kungenjalo ifomu ngeke lithunyelwe.
forms.complete_ready: Yonke inkambu edingekayo igcwalisiwe. Leli fomu selilungele ukuqedelwa.
forms.final_frozen: Kuqedelwe ngo-{at}. Lena yirekhodi yalokho okwathunyelwa futhi ayisashintshi.
forms.reason_hint: Kugcinwa erekhodini lokucwaninga eceleni kwenani lokuqala
forms.submit_body: Ukuqedela kumisa ifomu njengerekhodi yalokho okuthunyelwe. Ngeke lisahlelwa ngemva kwalokho.
forms.submitted_body: Lena yirekhodi yalokho okwathunyelwa. Khiqiza ifomu elisha uma kukhona okushintshile.
forms.finalise_blocked: Izinkambu ezingu-{count} kusamele zigcwaliswe ngaphambi kokuthumela.

settings.title: Izilungiselelo ze-SHEQ
settings.subtitle: Imininingwane yomqashi, amafomethi ezinkomba nemithetho
settings.employer_hint: Lokhu kuvela kuwo wonke amafomu omthetho. I-W.Cl.2 ngeke ithunyelwe ngaphandle kwenombolo ye-COIDA.
settings.coida_missing_body: Yengeza manje futhi wonke ama-W.Cl.2 azolandela azoyithwala.
settings.coida_missing_with_incidents: Kunezigameko ezingu-{count} okumele zibikwe futhi awekho ama-W.Cl.2 azo angathunyelwa ngaphandle kwayo.
settings.references_hint: Isiqalo kuzo zonke izinkomba. Ukushintsha akubuyi kunikeze izinombolo ezikhona kakade.
settings.triage_sla_hint: Isikhathi ingozi ebikiwe engalinda ngaso ngaphambi kokuhlolwa
settings.effectiveness_days_hint: Isikhathi ngemva kokuvala isenzo ngaphambi kokuhlolwa kokusebenza kwaso
settings.anonymous_hint: Isisebenzi esesaba ukusolwa asibiki lutho. Ukuvala lokhu kucindezela ukubika.
settings.contractor_requirements_hint: Akekho ovela kumnikontileka ongena endaweni ngaphambi kokuthi konke lokhu kube sefayelini futhi kusasebenza. Ukumaka ibhokisi lapha kuvimba abanikontileka ababesebenza izolo.
settings.contractor_requirements_site_note: Lokhu okumisiwe kwenkampani. Indawo ingafuna uhlu lwayo — lokho kusethwa endaweni uqobo, ngaphansi kwezindawo.
settings.contractor_requirements_none: Akukho okudingwayo, ngakho umnikontileka uhambisana nemithetho ngaso leso sikhathi ebhalisiwe. Lesi yisinqumo ongasithatha; akusikho okumisiwe.

inspections.no_templates: Awekho amathempulethi. Ukuhlola akunalutho olungabuzwa ngaphandle kwalo.
inspections.question: Umbuzo
inspections.critical_hint: Umbuzo obalulekile owehlulekayo wehlulisa ukuhlolwa konke, noma ngabe amaphuzu athini.
inspections.code_hint: Onobumba abakhulu, izinombolo nokuxhuma — isb. CON-SCAFFOLD
inspections.need_template_first: Udinga ithempulethi eshicilelwe ngaphambi kokuba kuhlelwe okuthile.
inspections.install_library: Umtapo wolwazi ojwayelekile wamashekhilisti angu-20 ezimbonini eziyishumi ufakwa ngokuzenzakalelayo. Uma usenalutho, buza umlawuli wesistimu ukuthi afake umtapo we-SHEQ.

investigations.title: Uphenyo
investigations.subtitle: Okwenzekile, kungani kwenzeka, nokuvimba ukuthi kuphinde kwenzeke
investigations.heading: Uphenyo
investigations.none_open: Akukho okuphenywayo. Izigameko zivela lapha uma zibikwa.
investigations.only_blames_people: Zonke izimbangela ezisemqoka kuze kube manje zisola umuntu. Bheka isimo esikuvumele lokho.
investigations.depth_hint: Ukujula kulandela ubunzima obungenzeka, hhayi okwenzekile.
investigations.confirm_body_approve: Ukugunyaza kwamukela imbangela esemqoka njengokutholakele kwenhlangano.
investigations.confirm_body_close: Ukuvala kubhala ukuthi inhlangano isikubhekene nalokhu.
investigations.confirm_body_reopen: Kudalwa ukubuyekezwa okusha. Okwamanje kugcinwa njengoba kunjalo.

ai.title: Isikhulu Sokuphepha se-AI
ai.subtitle: Imidwebo elungiswe umsizi, ilinde isinqumo somuntu.
ai.boundary_body: Umsizi uyaphakamisa; awukaze uqophe. Akukho okukuleli khasi okunomthelela kuze kube uyakwamukela, futhi igama lakho lifakwa kulokho okwamukelayo.
ai.unverified_waiting: Imidwebo engu-{count} yenza izimangalo ezingenamthombo osekelayo. Leyo ibalwa kuqala.
ai.queue_empty: Akukho okulindile. Imidwebo ivela lapha uma umsizi ecelwa.
ai.no_source: Awukho umthombo osekelayo — hlola lokhu ngaphambi kokwamukela
ai.note_hint: Kuyadingeka ukuze wenqabe. Kuyisibonakaliso esicacile sokuthi umsizi uphambuka kuphi.
ai.never_body: Lezi zinqumo ziphathelene nesibopho somthetho somuntu siqu. Zigcinelwe umuntu oqanjiwe futhi umsizi uvinjelwe kuzo ngekhodi, hhayi nje ukutshelwa ukuthi azigweme.
ai.chat_scope: Izimpendulo zivela kumarekhodi e-SHEQ nezinsiza zalenkampani. Akukho lapha okushintsha irekhodi.

approvals.title: Izimvume
approvals.subtitle: Izinqumo ezikulindele, nezicelo ozifakile.
approvals.designer_subtitle: Klama ukuthi ubani ovuma ini, ngenkampani.
approvals.versioned: Izicelo esezivele ziqhubeka zigcina izinyathelo eziqale ngazo.

audits.title: Ukuhlolwa
audits.subtitle: Ukuhlolwa kwangaphakathi, kwabahlinzeki nokuqinisekiswa.
audits.root_cause_hint: Kungani kwenzekile — hhayi ukuthi wenzeni ngakho.

suppliers.title: Ukubhaliswa kwabahlinzeki
suppliers.subtitle: Ukuhlolwa kwe-SHEQ ngaphambi kokuba umhlinzeki asebenze endaweni.
suppliers.invite_note: Isimemo sibalula amadokhumenti okumele akhiqizwe yileli zinga lengozi, ukuze athunyelwe kanye kunokuba atholakale ngokwenqatshwa ngakunye.

ppe.title: PPE
ppe.subtitle: Okukhishiwe, kubani, nokuthi kufanele kushintshwe nini.
ppe.empty_catalogue: Akukho lutho ekhathalogu okwamanje, ngakho akukho okungakhishwa. Sebenzisa u-“Phatha ikhathalogu nesitoko” ukwengeza izinto le nkampani ezikhishayo — izicathulo, izigqoko zokuvikela, amagilavu — futhi umise ukuthi kungaki okusheleni.
ppe.issue_note: Okunikeziwe, kunikezwe bani. Usuku lokushintsha luphuma esikhathini sokuphila kwento.
ppe.serial_hint: Kwezinto ezihlolwa noma ezibuyiswa ngayinye, njengebhande lokuzivikela.

medical.title: Ukuhlolwa kwezempilo
medical.subtitle: Ukufaneleka komsebenzi, nokuhlolwa okuzayo.
medical.clinical_hint: Ulwazi lwezempilo. Lubethelwe, futhi lubonakala kuphela ngemvume yedatha yezokwelapha.
medical.clinical_failed: Imininingwane yezokwelapha ayikwazanga ukulayishwa. Akukho okukhonjiswayo esikhundleni serekhodi elingenalutho, elingafundeka njengokungekho okutholakele.
medical.clinical_warning: Imininingwane yezempilo ngaphansi kwe-POPIA s26. Ukuyifunda kuqoshwa ku-akhawunti yakho.
medical.record_note: Ukuhlolwa okwenziwe. Imininingwane yezokwelapha igcinwa ngokwehlukene futhi ifundwa kuphela yilabo abanelungelo.
medical.expires_hint: Shiya kungenalutho ukuze kusetshenziswe isikhathi sokusebenza esibekelwe lokhu kuhlolwa.
medical.restrictions_hint: Kuyadingeka. Umkhawulo ongabhalwanga ushiya umphathi eqagela.
medical.clinical_encrypted: Kubethelwe lapho kugcinwe khona futhi kufundwa kuphela yilabo abanelungelo lemininingwane yezokwelapha.

environmental.title: Imvelo
environmental.subtitle: Amanzi, amandla, uphethiloli, udoti nekhabhoni.
environmental.no_factor: Lawa mamitha awanaso isilinganiso sokukhishwa, ngakho awengezi lutho enanini lekhabhoni:
environmental.record_note: Ukufundwa kwemitha, kunosuku. Inani eliphelele lekhabhoni libalwa kabusha kusuka kulo kusetshenziswa isilinganiso sokukhipha somitha.

equipment.title: Imishini yokuphepha
equipment.subtitle: Izicimamlilo, amabhande, imishini yokuphakamisa nosizo lokuqala.

visitors.title: Izivakashi
visitors.subtitle: Imvume, isingeniso, nokuthi ubani osendaweni manje.
visitors.roll_call: Lolu uhlu lokubiza amagama. Ngemva kwe-alamu, yilona uhlu kuphela olubalulekile.
visitors.no_workflow_detail: Ayikho inqubo yokuvuma izivakashi, ngakho akekho ogunyaziwe ukungenisa umuntu. Setha eyodwa kuqala.
visitors.request_note: Ukuvakasha kumele kuvunywe ngaphambi kokuba kungene umuntu, ngakho lokhu kuyisicelo hhayi ukufika.
visitors.expected_to_hint: Ngemva kwalesi sikhathi isivakashi sibhalwa njengesihlala isikhathi eside.

emergency.title: Isimo esiphuthumayo
emergency.subtitle: Amasu, izindawo zokuhlangana nokusebenza kokuzilolonga.
emergency.uncovered: Alikho icebo lesimo esiphuthumayo elibhalelwe: {types}. Akekho onenqubo angayilandela kulokhu.
emergency.record_drill_note: Ukulungiselela okwenziwe. Inani labangatholakali yilona elinquma ukuthi kuphumelele yini.

training.title: Ukuqeqeshwa kokuphepha
training.subtitle: Kufundwa ku-Learning Management. Amarekhodi awaphindwa lapha.
training.unavailable: I-Learning Management ayifakiwe, ngakho ayikho idatha yokuqeqeshwa engaboniswa.

integrations.title: Ukuhlanganiswa kwesango
integrations.subtitle: Xhuma uhlelo lwakho lokulawula ukungena noma lokuklokha. Faka iziqinisekiso, hlola, bese ugcizelela.
integrations.none: Akukho ukuxhumana okwamanje. Engeza okukodwa ukuqala ukuhlola abantu esangweni.
integrations.label: Igama
integrations.monitor_first: Ukuxhumana okusha kuqala ngemodi yokubheka: ukwenqaba kuyaqoshwa kodwa akekho ovinjwayo. Kubheke isonto, ususe izinsalela, bese ugcizelela.
integrations.enforce_warning: Kusukela manje, abantu abehlulekayo ekuhlolweni bazovinjwa esangweni. Ngokusekelwe ezinsukwini ezingu-30 ezedlule, okungena okungu-{refused} bekuzokwenqatshwa. Qinisekisa ukuthi lezo zinsalela zisusiwe kuqala.

inductions.title: Ukwethulwa
inductions.subtitle: Okutshelwa abantu ngaphambi kokunyathela endaweni.
inductions.author: Bhala ukwethulwa
inductions.bulk_how: Landa isifanekiso, sigcwalise, usilayishe. Hlola kuqala — akukho okulondolozwayo kuze ucindezele u-Ngenisa.

talks.title: Izingxoxo zokuphepha
talks.subtitle: Okutshelwe iqembu, obani ababekhona, nalokho abakuphakamisile.
talks.attendees_hint: Kuyadingeka. Ingxoxo engenabantu ababekhona ifakazela ukuthi sihlele okuthile, hhayi ukuthi kukhona otshelwe.
talks.concerns_hint: Noma yini ephakanyiswe lapha iba isenzo, ngakho ayilahleki uma ingxoxo iphela.
talks.record_note: Inkulumo engenalo uhlu lwababekhona ifakazela ukuthi kwalungiswa okuthile, hhayi ukuthi kukhona owaziswayo.

ppe_config.title: Ikhathalogi ne-stoko ye-PPE
ppe_config.subtitle: Lokho inkampani ekukhiphayo, nokuthi kungakanani okusesheluvini.
ppe_config.read_only: Ungabuka lolu lungiselelo kodwa awukwazi ukulushintsha.
ppe_config.empty_help: Ayikho into ekhathalogi okwamanje. Engeza izinto inkampani ezikhiphayo — izicathulo, izigqoko zokuphepha, amagilavu — bese ubeka ukuthi zingaki esheluvini. Irejista yokukhipha ifunda lapha.
ppe_config.low_warning: Imigqa yesitoko engu-{n} isezingeni lokuyala noma ngaphansi kwalo.
ppe_config.sized_hint: Maka lokhu uma into ikhishwa ngamasayizi, ukuze isitoko sibalwe ngesayizi ngasinye.
ppe_config.reorder_hint: Xwayisa uma inani lehla lifika kuleli
ppe_config.site_hint: Shiya kungenalutho uma isitoko singagcinwa ngesayithi
ppe_config.stock_hint: Umugqa owodwa ngento ngayinye, usayizi nesayithi. I-PPE enosayizi ibalwa ngosayizi, ngoba ukuphelelwa usayizi owodwa akufani nokuphelelwa into.

import.title: Ngenisa izinto ze-PPE
import.subtitle: Layisha ikhathalogu kusuka kwispredishithi esikhundleni sokuyithayipha.
import.matched_on_code: Izinto zifaniswa ngekhodi — ikhodi ekhona iyabuyekezwa, ayiphindwaphindwa.

reports.title: Imibiko
reports.subtitle: Wonke amarejista emojuli, njengombiko ongawuhlunga futhi uwuthumele.
reports.not_periodic: Lo mbiko uchaza isimo njengamanje, ngakho ububanzi bosuku abusebenzi.

help.incidents_by_type: Mangaki alolu hlobo ngalunye, mangaki okumele abikwe, nezinsuku ezilahlekile.
help.incidents_detail: Zonke izigameko esikhathini, umugqa owodwa ngasinye.
help.actions_overdue: Sekudlule usuku lokugcina futhi akukaqedwa — uhlu okumele lusetshenzwe.
help.ppe_issued: Okwakhishwa, kukhishelwa bani, nokuthi kufanele kushintshwe nini.
help.ppe_usage_by_item: Ukusetshenziswa ngento — okumele kubhajethwe futhi ku-odwe kabusha.
help.ppe_replacements_due: I-PPE ekhishiwe esifika ekugcineni kwempilo yayo.
help.ppe_stock: Okusesheluvini, nokuthi yini esiwele ezingeni lokuyala.
help.inductions_completed: Ubani owethuliwe, amaphuzu akhe, nokuthi kuphela nini.
help.visitors: Ubani owafika esayithini, nokuthi wahamba nini.
help.visitors_on_site: Wonke umuntu ongenile ongaphumanga — uhlu lokubalwa kwabantu.
help.permits: Imvume ekhishwe esikhathini nesimo sayo samanje.
help.emergency_drills: Ukuzilolonga okwenziwe, ukubamba iqhaza nesikhathi sokuphuma.
help.environmental_readings: Ukufundwa kwemitha nokuthi kuguqulelwa kumalini we-CO₂e.
help.contractors_access: Ukuthi umqashi ngamunye angaba yini esayithini njengamanje.

approvals_setup.read_only: Ungabuka lezi zinqubo kodwa awukwazi ukuzishintsha.
approvals_setup.edit_hint: Ukulondoloza kwakha inguqulo {n}. Izicelo esezisemsebenzini zigcina izinyathelo eziqale ngazo.
approvals_setup.retire_confirm: Thathisa u-“{name}” umhlalaphansi? Iyeka ukusetshenziswa kokusha. Izicelo esezisemsebenzini ziyayigcina futhi zingaqedwa.

hints.permit: Ubani osayina imvume ngaphambi kokuqala umsebenzi

sites.add_sub: Indawo lapho kwenziwa khona umsebenzi engekho esakhiweni senkampani — inqolobane eqashiwe, indawo yeklayenti, ingxenye yomgwaqo.
sites.structure_warning: Igama nokuthi iyasebenza yini kubekwa yisakhiwo senkampani futhi kuzobuyiselwa ekuvumelaniseni okulandelayo. Konke okunye kuhlala.
sites.hint_timezone: Imikhawulo yesikhathi yomthetho ibalwa kulesi sikhathi
sites.hint_reference: Inombolo yenkontileka noma yomsebenzi, uma isiza
sites.requirements_hint: Indawo yokucwenga nehhovisi akufanele kudinge amaphepha afanayo. Setha uhlu lwale ndawo, noma uyiyeke ilandele inkampani.
sites.requirements_inherit_hint: Ukulandela kusho ukuthi le ndawo iyashintsha uma uhlu lwenkampani lushintsha. Ukukucisha akuvimbi lutho — indawo nje isho olwayo.
sites.requirements_none_warning: Uma kungamakiwe lutho, noma yimuphi umnikontileka kule ndawo uhambisana nemithetho ngaso leso sikhathi ebhalisiwe.

triage.title: Ulayini wokuhlunga
triage.subtitle: Izigameko ezilinde ukuthathwa umuntu, umnqamulajuqu oseduze kuqala.
triage.dialog_help: Qinisekisa ukuthi bekungaba kubi kangakanani futhi ubize ozokuqedela. Ukushintsha izinga kushintsha umnqamulajuqu.
triage.potential_hint: Okwakungenzeka, hhayi okwenzekile. U-5 wayengabulala umuntu.

alert.title: Izexwayiso zokuphepha
alert.subtitle: Ukuyisa okutholakele kubantu ababhekene nengozi efanayo.
alert.needs_why: Sho ukuthi kungani kwenzekile noma yini eshintshiwe ngaphambi kokukhipha.

injury.title: Amacala okulimala
injury.subtitle: Ubani ongekho emsebenzini, ubani osemsebenzini olula, nobani osebuyile.
injury.still_running: Lo muntu unesikhathi esivulekile ngaphandle kosuku lokugcina, ngakho izinsuku zisabalwa.
injury.event_hint: Ukuphumula nomsebenzi olula kubala izinsuku. Okunye kungumlando wokunakekelwa.

permit.no_approvals: Akukho zinyathelo zokugunyaza ezilungiselelwe lolu hlobo lwemvume.
permit.suspend_hint: Iqembu libona lesi sizathu, ngakho sho ukuthi kumele kulungiswe ngaphambi kokuthi umsebenzi uqhubeke.
permit.override_warning: Uyamukela, egameni lakho, ukuthi umuntu angenza umsebenzi angenalo ithikithi lawo njengamanje. Lokhu kuqoshwa emvumeni nasemzileni wokucwaninga.
permit.no_closure_checks: Lolu hlobo lwemvume alumemezeli ukuhlolwa kokuvala.

board.title: Ibhodi Lezimvume Elibukhoma
board.subtitle: Umsebenzi osegunyeni elibhaliwe njengamanje
board.uncovered: Izimvume ezibukhoma ezingu-{count} azinakuhlolwa kwengozi okugunyaziwe okumboza indawo. Igunya imvume elime kulo alikho.
board.empty: Akukho zimvume ezibukhoma. Akukho lutho olusebenzwa ngegunya elibhaliwe njengamanje.

ra.needs_lines: Engeza okungenani umugqa owodwa wengozi ngaphambi kokuthi lokhu kugunyazwe.
ra.needs_participants: Qopha ukuthi obani ababambe iqhaza ngaphambi kokuthi kugunyazwe — iMithetho yokwaKha ne-MHSA bobabili bakudinga.
ra.weak_control_line: Umugqa {sequence}: {hazard} iyingozi ephezulu noma ebucayi elawulwa kuphela ngezinyathelo zokuphatha noma izivikelo zomuntu.
ra.approved_locked: Ukuhlola okugunyaziwe akukwazi ukuhlelwa. Kunalokho dala ukubuyekezwa; le nguqulo ihlala erekhodini ngoba izigameko zahlulelwa ngayo.
ra.no_lines: Akukho migqa yengozi okwamanje. Ukuhlola okungenamigqa kuvimba yonke imvume ekubhekisela.
ra.participants_hint: Abantu abenza umsebenzi kumele babambe iqhaza ekuhloleni ingozi yawo.
ra.controls_hint: Esinamandla kuqala. Ingozi ephezulu ebanjwe kuphela ngezinyathelo zokuphatha noma izivikelo zomuntu iyaphawulwa.

contractor.subtitle: Ukuthi laba bantu bangaba endaweni yini, nokuthi yini ebavimbayo
contractor.blocked_title: Laba bantu abakwazi ukuza endaweni okwamanje
contractor.compliant: Lo sonkontileka uhlangabezana nalokho okufunwa yile ndawo.
contractor.title: Isihloko
contractor.expiry_hint: Shiya usuku lokuphela kungagcwalisiwe kwidokhumenti elingapheli. Idokhumenti elidlule usuku lwalo lokuphela livimba ukungena.
contractor.induction_hint: Ukwethulwa oseluphelelwe isikhathi kubalwa njengokungekho, futhi kuyisizathu esivame kakhulu sokuthi isisebenzi siphendulwe esangweni.
contractor.override_warning: Uyamukela, egameni lakho, ukuthi laba bantu bangaba endaweni ngaphandle kwamadokhumenti afunwa yile ndawo. Nikeza usuku — ukudlulisa okungenasiphetho kuba okwaphakade ngephutha.
contractor.drop_hint: Amaningi ngesikhathi esisodwa, noma i-zip eyodwa ephethe ifayela lokuphepha lonke — ivulwa ibe idokhumenti elilodwa ngefayela ngalinye.
contractor.photo_hint: Indlela indlu yesango yazi ngayo ukuthi umuntu osesangweni nguye umuntu osohlwini.
contractor.not_linked: Akuxhunyiwe kurekhodi lokuPhatha abaHlinzeki, ngakho ifayela labo lokuphepha nerekhodi labo lezohwebo ngeke afundwe ngokuqhathaniswa.
contractor.set_aside_note: Idokhumenti lihlala efayeleni njengobufakazi futhi liyeka ukubalwa ekuhambisaneni. Sebenzisa lokhu ukulungisa usuku lokuphela olungalungile: ukunamathisela isitifiketi esifanele akwanele ngokwaso, ngoba ukuhlola kugcina noma yiliphi idokhumenti eliphela muva.
contractor.set_aside_hint: Kuqoshwe egameni lakho. Umbuyekezi obuza ukuthi kungani isitifiketi siyekile ukubalwa ufunda lokhu.
contractor.pass_hint: Isango liskena lokhu bese lithola impendulo ebukhoma. Ikhodi ayiphethe lutho ngaphandle kwesikhombisi — akukho nombolo kamazisi, akukho mniningwane yezempilo, akukho sitifiketi — ngakho kuhlala kuphephile ukuprinta, ukuthwebula nokudlulisa.
contractor.worker_site_hint: Shiya kungenalutho ukuze kulandele isiza sikasonkontileka.
contractor.pass_rotate_warning: Ikhadi eliprintiwe liyeka ukusebenza masinyane futhi kumele kukhishwe elisha. Sebenzisa lokhu lapho ikhadi lilahlekile noma umuntu esehambile.
contractor.sites_hint: Ukuvunywa kwesinye isiza akusikona ukuvunywa kwesinye. Isiza esivimba lo sonkontileka siyamenqabela lapho noma ngabe ifayela lakhe lithini kwezinye izindawo.
contractor.sites_none: Azikho iziza ezisebenzayo okumele kunqunywe ngazo okwamanje.
contractor.site_conditions_hint: Iprintwa esinqumweni sasesangweni uma ikhadi labo liskenwa lapha. Isibonelo: ahanjiswe njalo, ngesikhathi sasemini kuphela.
contractor.site_reason_required: Kuyadingeka. Ukuvinjwa okungenasizathu akukho muntu ongakususa.
contractor.site_block_warning: Lokhu kubenqabela kulesi siza kuphela, futhi kubenqabela noma ngabe isimo sabo senkampani yonke sithini.

files.drop_hint: noma chofoza ukukhetha. I-zip ivulwa ibe irekhodi elilodwa ngefayela ngalinye elingaphakathi.

library.title: Umtapo wamadokhumenti
library.subtitle: Izinqubo ezisebenzayo, njengoba zisebenza kuwe
library.owing: Amadokhumenti angu-{count} alindele ukuthi uqinisekise ukuthi uwafundile.
library.watermark_note: Ikhophi ngayinye iphethe inguqulo yayo, usuku lokushicilela nophawu lwekhophi engalawulwa. Ikhophi ephrintiwe isebenza kuphela ngosuku eyaphrintwa ngalo.

exposure.title: Amahora Asetshenziwe
exposure.subtitle: Ukuchayeka okuhlukaniswa ngakho wonke amazinga okulimala
exposure.site_hint: Shiya kungagcwalisiwe kwinkampani yonke. Thwebula ngendawo kuphela uma ubika ngendawo.
exposure.basis_hint: Lapho inani livela khona. Noma yini ngaphandle kwenani elifakwe ngesandla yenza amazinga wenyanga akwazi ukucwaningwa.
exposure.estimated_note: Izinyanga ezingu-{count} zincike kwinani elifakwe ngesandla, ngakho amazinga azo ayizilinganiso.
exposure.missing: Izinyanga ezingu-{count} azinamahora, ngakho i-LTIFR, i-TRIR, i-DIFR nezinga lobukhulu ngeke kubalwe kuzo.
exposure.footnote: Amazinga ngamahora angu-200 000 asetshenziwe. Inyanga engenamahora iyashiywa ezingeni lonyaka kunokubalwa njengo-0.

mine.title: Lapho Ngimi
mine.subtitle: Amathikithi ami, ukuhlolwa kwempilo nokufunda, njengokuba uhlelo kunako
mine.no_record: Awunarekhodi lesisebenzi okwamanje, ngakho akukho lutho esefayeleni ongalukhombisa. Cela lowo owasungula i-akhawunti yakho akufake ohlwini lwabasebenzi — kuze kube yilapho, uhlelo alikwazi ukukutshela lapho umi, futhi ngeke liqagele.
mine.nothing_on_file: Akukho okuqoshwe ngakho okwamanje, futhi akukho okufunwe kuwe. Lokhu akufani nokuhambisana — kusho ukuthi akukho lutho okumele kuhlolwe.
mine.blocking: {count} lamathikithi akho aphelelwe isikhathi futhi akuvimba ukusebenza. Ngeke ukhishelwe imvume noma usayinwe emsebenzini kuze kube luvuselelwe.
mine.gaps_hint: Lokhu kufunwe kuwe futhi akukho rekhodi ngakho. Ithikithi eliphelelwe isikhathi lidinga ukuvuselelwa; lokhu kumele kuhlelwe.
mine.induction_not_current: Ukwethulwa kwakho kwendawo akusekho esikhathini. Ungase uphendulwe esangweni.
mine.unacknowledged: Izinqubo ezingu-{count} zilindele ukuthi uqinisekise ukuthi uzifundile
mine.footnote: Leli yirekhodi elifanayo elifundwa yizincwadi zokubhalisa nesango. Uma okuthile lapha kungalungile, kungalungile yonke indawo — tshela isikhulu sakho sokuphepha kunokuba usebenze ngendlela ezungeza.

matrix.title: Imethrikisi Yamakhono
matrix.subtitle: Ngubani ofanelekele ini, nalapho sishoda khona
matrix.no_gaps: Lonke ikhono elidingekayo liphethwe yibo bonke elidingeka kubo.
matrix.capped: Kukhombisa abantu abangu-{shown} kwabangu-{total}. Igridi ibanzi ngokwemvelo, ngakho inqunyelwe.
matrix.nothing_required: Alikho ikhono eselidingwe kunoma ubani. Lokhu akufani nokuthi wonke umuntu uyahambisana — kusho ukuthi akukho okungahlolwa ngakho.
matrix.footnote: Izidingo ezinamathiselwe endimeni, emnyangweni noma endaweni zixazululwa lapho lowo mongo waziwa; le gridi ikhombisa lezo ezinamathiselwe kubantu ngqo. Ithikithi eliphelelwa isikhathi lisabalwa njengeliphethwe — lisebenza namuhla.

safety_file.title: Ifayela Lokuphepha
safety_file.subtitle: Sonke isigaba esifunwa yilo mnikazi wendawo, nokukhona kuso ngasinye.
safety_file.nothing_required: Akukho sigaba esisafunwa, ngakho ifayela alikwazi ukuba liphelele noma lingaphelele. Khetha iphrofayela yomkhakha wakho bese uyilungisa — yilokho okusho ukuthi yiziphi izigaba ezibalulekile lapha.
safety_file.complete: Sonke isigaba esifunwayo sigculisiwe. Leli fayela alidingi ikhophi yephepha.
safety_file.history_count: {count} kurekhodiwe. Lesi sigaba singumlando kunokuba bube ubufakazi, ngakho akudingeki sigcwaliswe.
safety_file.drop_hint: Yehlisa izitifiketi lapha. Ifolda ye-zip ivulwa ibe idokhumenti elilodwa ngefayela ngalinye.
safety_file.reason_hint: Kuqoshwe egameni lakho, futhi usonkontileka utshelwa ukuthi kuthini.
safety_file.valid_until_hint: Shiya kungagcwalisiwe ukuthola izinyanga ezingu-{months} kusukela namuhla. Iphuma ekugunyazweni ngalolu suku noma ngabe ukhona ovula isikrini noma akekho.
safety_file.reject_hint: Usonkontileka kumele atshelwe okumele akulungise. Ukwenqaba okungenasizathu kuqala ucingo kunokuba kuqale idokhumenti elilungisiwe.
safety_file.warning_days_hint: Shiya kungagcwalisiwe ukusebenzisa okumisiwe. Kumise ngesikhathi esidingekayo ngempela ukushintsha leli dokhumenti.
safety_file.site_hint: Shiya kungagcwalisiwe lapho kusebenza kuzo zonke izindawo. Idokhumenti lendawo ethile akumele livimbe usonkontileka kwezinye izindawo.
safety_file.activities_hint: Shiya kungagcwalisiwe lapho kusebenza kuwo wonke umsebenzi. Ithikithi lokuphakamisa libalulekile ekuphakamiseni, hhayi ekupendeni.
safety_file.filed_as_hint: Kulethwe kusho ukuthi lifikile futhi kusemele lihlolwe ngumuntu. Aligculisi lutho kuze kube liyamukelwa.

state_hint.APPROVED: Umuntu onekhono wamukele leli fayela. Liyeka ukusebenza ngosuku olungezansi.
state_hint.SUSPENDED: Alinqatshwa, kodwa alisebenzi nje futhi. Abantu babo bayenqabelwa esangweni.
state_hint.EXPIRED: Ukugunyazwa kuphelelwe isikhathi. Kumele kuthunyelwe ifayela elisha.

move_hint.submit: Linikeza ifayela kunoma ubani obuyekeza amafayela osonkontileka lapha. Alikwazi ukuthunyelwa ngenkathi isigaba esifunwayo singagculisiwe.
move_hint.request_changes: Libuyisa nohlu lwalokho okumele kushintshe. Okulandelayo okuthunyelwa ngusonkontileka kuyinguqulo entsha, futhi lokhu kugcina isizathu sakho.
move_hint.approve: Lamukela ifayela njengoba limi namuhla. Ukugunyazwa kuyisitatimende mayelana namadokhumenti akulo ngalolu suku, ngakho kuphatha usuku lokuphela.
move_hint.suspend: Kumisa ukugunyazwa ukusebenza ngaphandle kokwenqaba ifayela. Abantu babo bayenqabelwa esangweni kuze kubuyiselwe.

safety_file.rules_hint: Isinqumo sakho, hhayi sohlelo. Yonke imibandela engezansi iyahlolwa futhi ibikwe noma kunjani; lezi zivule zinqumela ukuthi yiziphi kuzo ezenqaba ngempela usonkontileka esangweni. Zisebenza kuwo wonke usonkontileka, ngoba ukuzisebenzisa ngokungalingani yikho okwenza inselelo esangweni iphumelele.

status_hint.COMPLIANT: Konke okufunwayo kusefayeleni, kusesikhathini futhi kwamukelwe.
status_hint.EXPIRING: Akukho okushodayo, kodwa okunye kuphelelwa isikhathi maduze.
status_hint.NON_COMPLIANT: Okunye okufunwayo akulungile. Ukhethe ukungenqabi ukungena ngenxa yakho.
status_hint.PENDING_APPROVAL: Ifayela likumbuyekezi. Akukho okushodayo — akekho osekwamukele.
status_hint.SUSPENDED: Umuntu umise leli fayela okwesikhashana. Lokho kudlula konke okubalwe.

rule.MISSING_MEDICAL: Umsebenzi udinga isitifiketi sokufaneleka futhi asikho
rule.MISSING_METHOD_STATEMENT: Umsebenzi udinga isitatimende sendlela futhi asikho esigciniwe
rule.MISSING_PERMIT: Umsebenzi udinga imvume yokusebenza futhi ayikho evuliwe
rule.MISSING_EQUIPMENT_CERTIFICATE: Umsebenzi udinga isitifiketi semishini futhi asikho esigciniwe

safety_file.always_blocks: kuhlala kwenqabela, futhi akuvalwa lapha. Isiza sinquma isango saso.

activities.title: Imisebenzi
activities.subtitle: Umsebenzi owenziwa esizeni, nokuthi uhlobo ngalunye ludinga ini ukuze luvunyelwe.
activities.name: Igama
activities.code_hint: Lokho okuthunyelwa yisifundi sekhadi, imvume noma i-API. Osonhlamvukazi, kungabi khona izikhala.
activities.requires_hint: Ubufakazi okumele umuntu abe nabo. Isisebenzi esingenabo obunye balobu buyenqatshelwa lo msebenzi ngegama.
activities.high_risk_hint: Kumaka ukuthi kubhekwe kabili. Isango lisebenza ngalokho umsebenzi okudingayo, hhayi ngalokhu.
activities.permit_hint: Imvume kumele ivulwe ngaphambi kokuba lo msebenzi uqale.
activities.retire_body: Ngeke usanikezwa. Izimvume nezehlakalo zokungena esezibhaliwe ngawo zihlala zifundeka, futhi ikhodi ingasetshenziswa futhi kamuva.
activities.empty_body: Kuze kube umsebenzi usho okudingayo, isango elibuzwa ukuthi “ngabe lo muntu angasebenza phezulu” alinalutho elingaluhlola futhi lidlulisa wonke umuntu. Qala ohlwini lwaseNingizimu Afrika oluhambisanayo bese ushintsha lokho ngamunye akudingayo.
activities.unstaffed: Imisebenzi engu-{n} okungekho muntu endaweni ofanelekayo kuyo njengamanje. Noma izitifiketi kumele zilandelwe, noma isidingo asilungile.
activities.advisory_body: Umuntu ongenabo ubufakazi obudingekayo uyadluliswa futhi igebe libhalwe phansi. Vula u-“Ikhono elingekho lomsebenzi” emithethweni yokuvimba osonkontileka ukuze kunqatshwe esikhundleni salokho.

attendance.title: Esizeni
attendance.subtitle: Ubani olapha manje, ubani ongenile waphuma, nobani ongazange aphume ngokusemthethweni.
attendance.long_stays_hint: Abantu abangu-{n} sebesesizeni isikhathi esingaphezu kwamahora angu-{hours}. Ishifu yasebusuku nayo ibukeka kanje — kodwa nesiza lapho kungekho muntu ophumayo ngokusemthethweni.
attendance.when_hint: Shiya kungenalutho ukuze kube manje. Isikhathi esedlule siyamukelwa, ukuze kubhalwe uhlu lwephepha; esizayo asamukelwa.
attendance.manual_note: Kuqoshwa njengokufakwe ngesandla, ukuze ukucwaninga kukwazi ukukuhlukanisa nokuskena. Isifundi esingasebenzi akusona isizathu sokushiya umuntu ohlwini.
attendance.monitor_only: Ngabe wenqatshelwe — leli sango lisekumodi yokuqapha.

overrides.title: Ukungena kwesikhashana
overrides.subtitle: Ubani odluliselwe esangweni okungafanele adlule kulo, nokuthi ngegunya likabani.
overrides.explainer: Ukweqa kuvumela umuntu ofayela lakhe lingekho ohlelweni. Kwenzelwe ukuba kube lula ukukunikeza — usonkontileka onomsebenzi ongenandlela yokungena yindlela abantu abangena ngayo ngegama lozakwabo — futhi kuphephile ngoba konke kubhalwe lapha nesizathu sakho, umvumi wakho nokuphela kwakho. Akukho okungasebenza isikhathi esingaphezu kwezinsuku ezingu-{days}.
overrides.grant_warning: Lokhu kungenisa esizeni umuntu obengenqatshelwa. Kubhalwa ngegama lakho, nangegama lomvumi omqambayo.
overrides.ending_soon_hint: Ukweqa okungu-{n} kuphela ezinsukwini ezimbili. Kuvuseleleni noma kuyekeni kuphelelwe — kodwa nquma, kunokuthi uthole esangweni.
overrides.reason_hint: Lokho okuzosetshenziswa ngumuntu okubuyekeza ezinyangeni eziyisithupha. Okungenani izinhlamvu eziyishumi.
overrides.conditions_hint: Lokho okumele bakwenze ngesikhathi kusebenza. Kuprintwa esinqumweni sasesangweni lapho ikhadi labo liskenwa.
overrides.starts_hint: Shiya kungenalutho ukuze kuqale manje. Ukweqa kokuvalwa kwemisebenzi kungahlelwa usuku ngaphambili.
overrides.ends_hint: Kuyadingeka, futhi okungenani izinsuku ezingu-{days} zizayo. Kuzivalela kokwako.
overrides.site_hint: Shiya kungenalutho kuzo zonke iziza. Ukukunciphisa kuyindlela ephephe kakhulu.
overrides.approver_hint: Umuntu okugunyazile, uma kungesiwe wena. Shiya kungenalutho futhi kubhalwe ngegama lakho.
overrides.revoke_body: Isango libuyela lapho belikhona, ngokushesha. Noma ubani othembele kulokhu ukuze angene esizeni kusasa uzonqatshelwa.

portal.title: Ukuhambisana kwakho kwezokuphepha
portal.subtitle: Lokho u-{host} akudingayo kuwe ngaphambi kokuba abantu bakho basebenze eziteni zabo.
portal.not_a_contractor_body: Awukho ohlwini lwabanikazi bezinkontileka zaleli khasimende, ngakho azikho izidingo zokuphepha ngakwi-akhawunti yakho. Uma abantu bakho besebenza eziteni zabo, bacele ukuthi bakufake.
portal.score_explained: Iphuzu elilodwa ngedokhumenti ngalinye, ifayela lakho lokuphepha, nesethulo somuntu ngamunye.
portal.nothing_required: Leli khasimende alikaceli lutho kuwe okwamanje.
portal.nothing_outstanding: Akukho okusasele. Usemumva nazo zonke izidingo.
portal.no_workers: Akekho kubantu bakho osohlwini lwaleli khasimende okwamanje.
portal.review_note: Noma yini oyithumelayo iyabuyekezwa ngaphambi kokuba ibalwe. Izobonakala ilindile ukubuyekezwa kuze kube bayamukela, ungathembeli kuyo esangweni ngaphambi kwalokho.
portal.file_hint: I-PDF, isithombe noma idokhumenti ye-Word, kufika ku-20 MB.
portal.upload_done: Kuthunyelwe. Bazokubuyekeza futhi kuzobalwa uma sekwamukelwe.

notices.title: Izaziso zosonkontileka

notices.what_we_send_hint: Sonke isaziso le sistimu esithumela usonkontileka, nokukubangelayo.
notices.unreachable_body: Abanalo ikheli ezindleleni ozikhethile, ngakho asikho kulezi zaziso esibafinyelelayo. Akukho okuphambanayo — abatshelwa nje, kuze kube khona othintwayo esangweni.

planning.over_budget: Leli pulani lidlula isabelomali esitholakalayo ngo-{amount}.
planning.delayed_subtitle: Sekudlule usuku lwethenda noma lokunikezwa futhi akukanikezwa

tenders.title: Ukubuyekezwa kwamathenda
tenders.subtitle: Ukuqalisa, ukuhlola, ukulinganisa nokuncoma ukunikezwa

tenders.create_review_hint: Izinkomba nekomiti kulungiswa okulandelayo, ngaphambi kokuvulwa kokuhlola.
tenders.plan_line_hint: Ukukhetha umugqa wepulani kuthatha imininingwane yawo.

methodologies.WEIGHTED_hint: Yonke inkomba ikalwa ibe yiphuzu elilodwa
methodologies.TWO_ENVELOPE_hint: Isango lobuchwepheshe kuqala, intengo ivulwa kuphela kwabaphumelele

tenders.weights_must_total: Izisindo zentengo nokukhethwa kufanele zibe ngu-100; manje zingu-{total}.
tenders.no_committees: Awekho amakomiti asebenzayo — dala elilodwa ngaphambi kokuba ukuhlola kuvuleke.
tenders.approval_level_hint: Umbhalo okhululekile: izinga legunya elidingwa yilokhu kunikezwa.
tenders.frozen_explainer: Izinkomba zavalwa ngo-{at}, lapho ukuhlola kuvuleka. Ushintsho manje ludinga isicelo soshintsho esigunyaziwe.
tenders.no_evaluators: Abekho abahloli abaqokiwe. Qoka ikomiti kuqala.
tenders.coi_outstanding_body: Ukuhlola akukwazi ukuvuleka ngaphambi kokuba wonke amalungu avotayo amemezele futhi noma yikuphi ukungqubuzana okumenyezelwe kuxazululwe.
tenders.no_recommendation: Asikho isincomo esikhiqiziwe. Gunyaza amaphuzu ekulinganiseni kuqala.
tenders.recommended_supplier_hint: Kuya kwibhidi elisesikhundleni esiphezulu; shintsha uma ikomiti lincoma okunye.
tenders.submitted_at_hint: Ibhidi elamukelwa ngemuva kokuvalwa liphawulwa njengelephuze.
tenders.preference_framework_hint: Lugcwalisa ukwahlukaniswa kwentengo nokukhetha okumiswe umthetho.
tenders.no_framework_for_jurisdiction: Alukho uhlaka olulungiselelwe lesi sifunda okwamanje.
tenders.framework_unverified_warning: I-{name} ayikaqinisekiswa ngokwenqubomgomo yakho yokuthenga eyamukelwe. Hlola amaphuzu ngaphambi kokunikeza ngawo.
tenders.unconvertible_body: Asikho isilinganiso sokushintshanisa esifakiwe sika-{currencies} maqondana no-{target}. Faka isilinganiso ku-Finance, ngaphandle kwalokho ukunika amaphuzu ngeke kukwazi ukuhlela lawa mathenda.

evaluations.title: Ukuhlola kwami
evaluations.subtitle: Amathenda oqokelwe ukuwanika amaphuzu
evaluations.none_hint: Amathenda azovela lapha uma sewuqokelwe ekomitini lokuhlola.
evaluations.declare_first: Qedela isimemezelo sakho sokungqubuzana kwezintshisekelo ngaphambi kokunika amaphuzu.
evaluations.conflict_blocked: Umemezele ukungqubuzana. Ukunika amaphuzu kumisiwe kuze kuxazululwe umlawuli.
evaluations.declaration_intro: Ngaphambi kokunika amaphuzu, memezela ukuthi unayo yini intshisekelo kunoma yimuphi umbhidi kuleli thenda.
evaluations.conflict_pending: Ukungqubuzana okumemezele kukumlawuli. Awukwazi ukunika amaphuzu kuze kuxazululwe.
evaluations.price_hidden: Lokhu ukuhlola kwamakhava amabili, ngakho izintengo zamabhidi zihlala zivaliwe kuze kuphele isigaba sobuchwepheshe.
evaluations.locked_body: Kuthunyelwe ngo-{date}. Lokhu ukubuyekezwa {revision}. Ukulungisa kudinga ukuvulwa kabusha okugunyaziwe, okugcina amaphuzu okuqala.
evaluations.submit_hint: Uma sekuthunyelwe amaphuzu akho ayakhiywa futhi abalelwe ephuzwini lekomiti.
evaluations.confirm_submit_body: Iphuzu lakho elikaliwe ngu-{score}. Ngemuva kokuthumela, izinguquko zidinga ukuvulwa kabusha okugunyaziwe.

moderation.title: Ukulinganisa
moderation.subtitle: Qhathanisa abahloli, xazulula umehluko, gunyaza amaphuzu okugcina
moderation.scores_approved: Amaphuzu okugcina ekomiti agunyaziwe. Isincomo singakhiqizwa manje.
moderation.open_items: Izinto ezingu-{n} zisavuliwe. Zixazulule ngaphambi kokugunyaza amaphuzu okugcina.
moderation.variance_hint: Izinkomba lapho abahloli behluka ngaphezu kuka-{pct}% wephuzu eliphezulu ziphawulwa ngokuzenzakalela.
moderation.reevaluate_warning: Lokhu kuvula kabusha amaphuzu athunyelwe ngumhloli. Amaphuzu okuqala ayagcinwa.

committees.title: Amakomiti okuhlola
committees.subtitle: Amakomiti amile, amalungu awo nokuqokwa kwawo
committees.type_hint: Isibonelo ukuhlolwa kwamabhidi noma ukwahlulela kwamabhidi.
committees.external_hint: Umuntu ongenayo i-akhawunti yenkundla, oqokwe ngaphandle kwenhlangano.
committees.needs_quorum: Linamalungu avotayo angu-{have} kanti ikhoramu lingu-{need}.

deviations.title: Ukuphambuka
deviations.subtitle: Izicelo zokuphambuka endleleni ejwayelekile yokuthenga
deviations.new_hint: Bhala lokho ongakwazi manje — ukuhlolwa kokuthobela kusebenza uma uthumela, hhayi uma ulondoloza.
deviations.motivation_hint: Yilokhu umcwaningimabhuku akufunda kuqala. Sho okwenzekile nokuthi kungani indlela ejwayelekile ingasetshenziswanga.
deviations.draft_notice: Ukulondoloza kugcina lokhu kuwuhlaka. Imithetho yokuthobela isebenza uma ukuthumela ukuze kugunyazwe.
deviations.no_rules: Inhlangano yakho ayikahleli imithetho yokuthobela yokuphambuka.
deviations.submit_body: Imithetho yokuthobela isebenza manje, futhi iketanga lokugunyaza likhethwa enanini, emnyangweni, ohlotsheni nasengozini yalokhu kuphambuka.
deviations.accept_warnings: Ngiyazamukela lezi zexwayiso futhi ngifuna ukuqhubeka
deviations.acceptance_reason_hint: Kubhalwa nokuhlolwa futhi kubonakala kubo bonke abagunyazi.

fields.reason_hint: Emishweni emibili, yini eyenza lokhu kudingeke.
fields.business_justification_hint: Kungani lokhu kuyinto elungile ukuthi inhlangano ikwenze.
fields.risk_assessment_hint: Yini engahamba kabi, nokuthi yini ekunciphisayo.
fields.proposed_alternative_hint: Okwacatshangwa esikhundleni salokho, nokuthi kungani kungasetshenziswanga.

workload.summary: Izikhulu ezingu-{officers}, ukuthenga okusebenzayo okungu-{active}, izenzo ezingu-{overdue} ezidlulelwe yisikhathi.

settings.subtitle: Amandla, imikhawulo, imithetho namaketanga okugunyaza
