settings.variance_hint: Phawula inkomba lapho abahloli behluka ngaphezu kwale ngxenye yephuzu eliphezulu.
settings.workload_order: Kumele kube ngaphezulu kwenani lomthwalo omkhulu.
settings.escalation_days_hint: Isikhathi ukugunyazwa okungahlala ngaso ngaphambi kokuba abaphathi batshelwe.
settings.require_coi_hint: Ukuhlola akukwazi ukuvuleka ngaphambi kokuba wonke amalungu avotayo amemezele.
settings.allow_reopen: Vumela ukuhlola okuthunyelwe ukuthi kuvulwe kabusha
settings.allow_reopen_hint: Ukuvulwa kabusha kubhala isizathu sakho futhi kugcina amaphuzu okuqala.
settings.block_over_budget_hint: Kuvaliwe ngokuzenzakalela: ezinye izinhlangano zihlela ngamabomu ngaphezulu.
settings.rules_explainer: Akukho lapha okubhalwe ngokuqinile kwanoma yimuphi umthetho. Amadokhumenti adingekayo, amazinga okugunyaza, imikhawulo, izinkambu eziphoqelekile, izimemezelo, imikhawulo yesikhathi nokukhuphuka konke kuhlelwa njengemithetho, ukuze isistimu efanayo isebenzele izinhlaka ezihlukene.
settings.no_rule_sets: Azikho izethi zemithetho ezihleliwe. Okuthunyelwayo kuzodlula ngaphandle kokuhlolwa kwemithetho.
settings.severity_hint: Ukwehluleka kuvimba ukuthumela; isexwayiso siyaphawula nje.
settings.framework_hint: Ngamarekhodi akho kuphela — akukho okuncika kukho.
settings.message_hint: Amagama akho athatha indawo yaleyo yesistimu.

rule_types.REQUIRED_DOCUMENT: Amadokhumenti abhaliwe kumele anamathiselwe futhi asebenze
rule_types.REQUIRED_APPROVAL: Ukugunyazwa ezingeni elifanele kumele kube khona

params.category_codes_hint: Amakhodi ahlukaniswe ngamakhefu, isb. TAX_CLEARANCE, BBBEE
params.min_steps_hint: Mangaki amazinga okugunyaza adingwa yileli nani
params.tolerance_pct_hint: Vumela ukudlula kuze kufike kule ngxenye

settings.chains_explainer: Iketanga limemezela ukuthi lisebenza nini. Okuhambisana kakhulu kuyanqoba, ukuze isicelo esifanayo sihambe ngendlela efanayo njalo.
settings.is_default: Sebenzisa uma lingekho elinye iketanga elihambisanayo
settings.is_default_hint: Okuzenzakalelayo okukodwa ngesihloko kugcina zonke izicelo zikwazi ukuhanjiswa.
settings.retire_chain_body: Iketanga liyeka ukudlulisela izicelo ezintsha. Izinqumo esezithathiwe ngalo zigcina irekhodi lazo, futhi akukho okusevunyiwe okushintshayo.
settings.chain_edit_warning: Izicelo ezingu-{n} okwamanje zidlula kuleli ketanga
settings.code_locked_hint: Ikhodi ikhomba leli ketanga futhi ayikwazi ukushintshwa.
settings.steps_hint: Ukugunyazwa kwenzeka ngalolu hlelo. Shintsha uhlelo ngemicibisholo.
settings.single_approver_hint: Umuntu oyedwa oqanjiwe usayina lesi sinyathelo.
settings.preference_explainer: Izinhlaka zokukhetha zinquma ukuthi umnikeli uthola malini ngaphandle kwentengo. Ifomula yentengo imiswe umthetho; amaphuzu abekwa inqubomgomo yakho, ngakho ithebula elifakiwe liyisiqalo kuze uliqinisekise.
settings.fx_basis_hint: Isilinganiso sosuku oluthile esiqhathanisa amathenda ngezimali ezehlukene.
settings.fx_basis_submission_warning: Ukuguqula ithenda ngalinye ngosuku lwalo lokuthumela kusho ukuthi amathenda amabili afanayo angaba nezikhundla ezehlukene ngenxa nje yokufika ngezinsuku ezehlukene.
settings.fx_rate_type_hint: Kufanele nohlobo olugcinwe ku-Finance, ngokuvamile i-spot.
settings.framework_no_bands: Awekho amabhande abekiwe. Akukho okuzonikezwa ngaphansi kwalolu hlaka kuze kubekwe.
settings.retire_framework_body: Uhlaka luyeka ukunikezwa kumathenda amasha. Amathenda asenikwe amaphuzu ngalo agcina irekhodi lawo.
settings.basis_hint: Amaphuzu anikeza umklomelo; umkhawulo unikeza inzuzo yentengo esikhundleni salokho.
settings.framework_notes_hint: Lokhu kusekelwe kukuphi, nanoma yini esadinga ukuqinisekiswa.
settings.bands_hint: Kuhlolwa ngokulandelana; ibhande lokuqala umnikeli alihambisanayo yilo elisebenzayo.
settings.confirm_verified: Ngiyaqinisekisa ukuthi lezi zibalo zihambisana nenqubomgomo yethu yokuthenga eyamukelwe
settings.confirm_verified_hint: Kubhalwa ngaphansi kwegama lakho. Ukuhlela izibalo kamuva kususa lokhu kuze kunikezwe futhi.
settings.confirm_verified_note: Lolu hlaka luzophawulwa njengoluqinisekisiwe, ngegama lakho, uma ulondoloza.

portal.local_content: Le thenda ihlangabezana nesidingo sokuqukethwe kwendawo
portal.confirm: Ngiyaqinisekisa ukuthi le thenda ilungile futhi ifakwe egameni lenkampani ebalulwe ngenhla
portal.confirm_hint: Uma isithunyelwe, ithenda yakho iyavalwa futhi ayikwazi ukushintshwa. Xhumana nesikhulu sokuthenga uma udinga ukuyishintsha.
portal.closed_warning: Leli thenda selivaliwe. Usengathumela, kodwa ithenda yakho izobhalwa njengephuzile futhi kuyikomiti elizonquma ukuthi ingacatshangelwa yini.
portal.received_body: Ihlala ivaliwe kuze kuvalwe ithenda, bese ivulwa kanye nawo wonke amanye amathenda yizikhulu ezimbili.
portal.received_late: Ithenda yakho yamukelwe ngemva kwesikhathi sokuvala
portal.received_late_body: Ibhalwe njengephuzile. Ukuthi ithenda ephuzile ingacatshangelwa yini kunqunywa yikomiti ngokwemithetho yalo.
portal.receipt_hint: Yigcine. Ikhomba ithenda yakho ngaphandle kokuyidalula.
portal.footer: Kuthunyelwe nge-Mkhaya Hub. Le link ingeyakho wedwa — ungayabelani nabanye.

intake.explainer: Abanikeli abamenyiwe bathumela ngesixhumanisi sabo. Amathenda ahlala evaliwe kuze kuvalwe ithenda, bese wonke avulwa ndawonye yizikhulu ezimbili.
intake.invite_hint: Kwenza isixhumanisi esiyimfihlo salo mnikeli. Msithumele — kuphela indlela yakhe yokungena.
intake.link_once: Kukhonjiswa kanye. Sikopishe manje — asisaboniswa futhi.
intake.withdraw_body: Ithenda elivaliwe liyasuswa ukuze lo mnikeli akwazi ukuthumela futhi. Kokubili ukuhoxiswa nethenda elisha kuhlala emkhondweni wokucwaninga.
intake.opening_explainer: Wonke amathenda avaliwe avulwa kanyekanye, nguwe nofakazi. Ukuvula kwenzeka kanye futhi akunakuhlehliswa.
intake.open_warning: Wonke amathenda avaliwe ayafundeka kulo mzuzu, futhi akunakubuyiselwa emuva. Qhubeka kuphela lapho ufakazi wakho ekhona.
intake.witness_hint: Umuntu wesibili, okhona ekuvulweni, obhalwe ethendeni.

analytics.title: Ukuhlaziya kokuthenga
analytics.subtitle: Ukuthi imojula yonke isebenza kanjani, hhayi nje ukuthi isebenzise malini
analytics.median_hint: Iphakathi, ukuze icala elilodwa elimile lingaphazamisi
analytics.pipeline_hint: Lapho umsebenzi uwela khona phakathi kokuhlela nokuvala.
analytics.competition_hint: Iphethini yamathenda anethenda elilodwa iyisibonakaliso esicacile kule datha.
analytics.bottlenecks_hint: Ngesinyathelo, ngoba iketanga liyanwabuzela uma isihlalo esisodwa sinwabuzela.
analytics.awards_hint: Ubani owanqoba ukunikezwa okungu-{n}, nangaphansi kwemiphi imithetho.
analytics.trend_hint: Isamba sisho lapho ukhona; uchungechunge lusho ukuthi uya ngakuphi.

budgets_approvals.title: Ukugunyazwa kwezabelomali
budgets_approvals.subtitle: Izinqumo ezikulindele, nalokho okulindele wena.
budgets_approvals.reject_reason_hint: Umuntu okuthumele uyakubona lokhu, ngakho sho ukuthi yini okumele ishintshe.
budgets_approvals.confirm_approve_body: Ukugunyaza “{label}” kuhambisa imali yangempela. Lokhu kuqoshwa egameni lakho.
budgets_approvals.covering_notice: Okunye kwalokhu kulapha ngoba umela ukugunyaza kuka-{names}.
budgets_approvals.given_sub: Ubani ophethe ukugunyaza kwakho kwezabelomali ngesikhathi ungekho. Bengezwa njengomgunyazi — usengaquma noma yini wena.
budgets_approvals.received_sub: Ukugunyaza kukabani ongakunquma, kuze kube nini.
budgets_approvals.delegate_sub: Omunye umuntu angaquma ukugunyaza kwakho kwezabelomali isikhathi esithile.
budgets_approvals.delegate_notice: Ukumela kungeza umgunyazi kunokudlulisa ilungelo, ngakho usengaquma noma yini wena. Ukwehlukanisa imisebenzi kusasebenza: akekho ongagunyaza lokho okuthunyelwe nguwe.
budgets_approvals.no_cover: Akekho okucele ukuba umele ukugunyaza kwakhe.
budgets_approvals.confirm_end_delegation_body: {to} akasakwazi ukunquma ukugunyaza kwakho. Izinqumo asezenzile azishintshi.
budgets_approvals.hint_from_user: Shiya kunguwe ngaphandle uma uhlelela omunye umuntu.
budgets_approvals.hint_ends_on: Shiya kungenalutho ukuze kungabi nasiphelo, isb. isikhundla esingenamuntu.

budgets_approval_setup.title: Ukudluliswa kokugunyazwa kwezabelomali
budgets_approval_setup.subtitle: Ubani osayina ini, kule nkampani.
budgets_approval_setup.default_notice: Ngaphandle kokudluliswa okuhleliwe, zonke izinqumo zesabelomali zisema emgqeni — futhi noma ubani ongagunyaza izabelomali angakunquma. Hlela indlela lapha uma ufuna ileli elithile, umthetho wamasiginesha amabili, noma umkhawulo lapho ngezansi kwawo kungadluliswa lutho.
budgets_approval_setup.no_hr_notice: Ayikho imojula ye-HR efakiwe, ngakho isinyathelo esibekwe ku-“imenenja yothumelayo” asikwazi ukwaneliswa muntu. Sebenzisa indima noma umuntu oqanjiwe kunalokho.
budgets_approval_setup.hint_adjustment: Ukunyusa, ukwehlisa noma ukudlulisa kwesabelo esikhona.
budgets_approval_setup.hint_reservation: Izimali ezibanjelwe isabelomali ngaphambi kokuba kube ne-oda lokuthenga.
budgets_approval_setup.confirm_delete_body: “{name}” ngeke isadlulisa lutho. Akukho okuvele kunqunyiwe okushintshayo.
budgets_approval_setup.confirm_delete_pending: “{name}” isenezinqumo ezingu-{count} emgqeni. Lezo zigcina ileli lazo nomlando wazo; akukho okusha okuzodluliswa ngayo.
budgets_approval_setup.steps_hint: Likhwelwa ngokulandelana. Qamba abantu ngomthetho lapho ungakwazi — indima iyaphila noma umuntu ehamba.
budgets_approval_setup.allow_self: Vumela umuntu othumele ukuthi agunyaze lesi sinyathelo

budgets_tracking.title: Ukulandelela izabelomali
budgets_tracking.subtitle: Ukuthi zimi kanjani zonke izabelomali, yini esiyikhathaza, nokuthi yini emisiwe.
budgets_tracking.position_hint: Okuboshiwe kufaka lokho okubekelwe nokukhiyiwe, hhayi kuphela lokho osekukhokhelwe nge-invoyisi.
budgets_tracking.rules_subtitle: Ukuthi le nkampani ifuna ukwaziswa nini, nokuthi ifuna ukumiswa nini.
budgets_tracking.block_notice: Umthetho oVimbayo kuphela owenqabayo. Uphoqelelwa lapho izimali zibekelwa noma ziboshwa khona, hhayi kuleli khasi kuphela.
budgets_tracking.no_rules: Ayikho imithetho okwamanje. Izabelomali ezidlulayo zisabikwa.
budgets_tracking.confirm_delete_rule_body: “{name}” uyeka ukubuka. Izexwayiso esezivele ziphakanyisiwe zixazululwa ekuhloleni okulandelayo.
budgets_tracking.ack_hint: Okwenziwayo ngakho. Isexwayiso sihlala sisebenza kuze kuphele isimo.

budgets_insights.analytics_sub: Ukuthi imali ibekwe kanjani, iyaphi, nokuthi yini elindele isinqumo.
budgets_insights.truncated: Kubonisa imigqa engu-500 yokuqala. Ukuthunyelwa kwe-CSV kunayo yonke.

report_sources.budgets: Kuqoshwa lapho isabelomali sidalwa, ku-Izabelomali › Isabelomali Esisha.
report_sources.ledger: Kususelwa encwadini yamabhuku yokubekelwa, ukubopha nokusetshenziswa kwemali.
report_sources.reservations: Kubhalwa lapho isicelo sokuthenga sigunyazwa, noma kufakwe ngesandla esabelweni.
report_sources.commitments: Kubhalwa lapho i-oda lokuthenga likhishwa, noma kufakwe ngesandla esabelweni.
report_sources.consumptions: Kubhalwa lapho i-invoyisi noma i-GRN ipositwa, noma kufakwe ngesandla esabelweni.
report_sources.adjustments: Kuphakanyiswa esabelweni njengokunyusa, ukwehlisa noma ukudlulisa.
report_sources.overrides: Kuphakanyiswa esabelweni lapho umuntu ecela ukusebenzisa imali ngaphesheya kwesabelo.
report_sources.approvals: Zonke izinqumo ezidluliselwe, zisuka emgqeni wokugunyaza.
report_sources.alerts: Kuphakanyiswa ukuhlolwa kwasebusuku ngokwemithetho yezexwayiso yale nkampani.
report_sources.phasing: Kuqoshwe kuthebhu ye-Phasing yesabelomali ngasinye: izikhathi ezivaliwe ezedlula umkhawulo womehluko wonyaka, nesizathu sokuthi ngasinye sihluleke ukufeza uhlelo lwaso.

chart.spend_empty: Ayikho imali eqoshiwe okwamanje. Ifika lapho i-invoyisi ipositwa, noma lapho umuntu eyiqopha esabelweni.
chart.cycle_sub: Amahora amaphakathi kusukela ekuthunyelweni kuya esinqumweni, ezinyangeni eziyisithupha ezedlule.

budgets_planning.title: Ukulungiselela izabelomali
budgets_planning.subtitle: Dlulisela unyaka, ngenisa owodwa usuka kwispredishithi, uvale lowo osuphelile.
budgets_planning.years_sub: Ukwabiwa ngezikhathi kudinga izikhathi; unyaka ongenazo awunalo uhlelo lokuqhathanisa nokusetshenziswa kwemali.
budgets_planning.no_periods_hint: Azikho izikhathi ezichaziwe. Zakhe Kumasethingi ukuze izabelomali zabiwe ngezikhathi.
budgets_planning.confirm_close_body: Izabelomali ku-{name} zivalwa kanye nawo. Ukubopha osekwenziwe kusadinga ukukhokhelwa nge-invoyisi.
budgets_planning.mode_allocation_hint: Unyaka olandelayo uqala ngenani lalo nyaka — indawo evamile yokuqala umjikelezo omusha.
budgets_planning.mode_unspent_hint: Unyaka olandelayo uqala ngalokho obekusatholakala. Izabelomali ezingenalutho ziyeqiwa.
budgets_planning.carry_notice: Konke kufika njengoluhlaka. Akukho okusebenzayo kuze kube khona ogunyazayo.
budgets_planning.import_sub: I-CSV, isuka ngqo kwispredishithi umjikelezo oqale kuso.
budgets_planning.import_notice: Imigqa ihlolwa ngamunye. Umugqa ombi ubikwa ngenombolo yomugqa; emihle isangeniswa, njengezinhlaka.
budgets_planning.template_sub: Yona kanye ifayela elifundwa umngenisi, nemigqa emibili yesibonelo egcwalisiwe.
budgets_planning.hint_target_year: Zonke izabelomali kufayela zidalwa kulo nyaka.
budgets_planning.hint_file: I-CSV kuphela, kufika ku-5 MB. Londoloza njenge-“CSV UTF-8” ku-Excel.
budgets_planning.how_1: Umugqa wokuqala kumele ube ngowesihloko. Amagama afaniswa ngaphandle kokunaka onobumba abakhulu futhi izikhala ziba ngama-underscore, ngakho “Allocated Amount” no-“allocated_amount” kuyikholomu efanayo.
budgets_planning.how_2: Ukulandelana kwamakholomu akunandaba, futhi amakholomu ongawadingi angashiywa ngokuphelele efayeleni.
budgets_planning.how_3: Umugqa ngamunye uhlolwa wodwa. Umugqa ohlulekayo ubikwa ngenombolo yawo yomugqa efayeleni futhi weqiwe — eminye isangeniswa.
budgets_planning.how_4: Konke kufika njengoluhlaka. Akukho okusebenzayo, futhi akukho okungena emgqeni wokugunyaza kuze kube khona okuthumelayo.
budgets_planning.how_5: Inani umngenisi angalazi — isigaba esibhalwe ngokungeyikho noma uhlobo lokusetshenziswa kwemali — alenzi umugqa uhluleke. Libuyela kokuzenzakalelayo bese libhalwa njengesexwayiso ngemuva.
budgets_planning.how_6: Akukho okuhlungwayo kabili. Ukulayisha ifayela elifanayo kabili kudala izabelomali kabili, ngakho ngenisa ifayela elilungisiwe onyakeni omusha noma qala ususe izinhlaka.
budgets_planning.col_help_name: Igama lesabelomali, isb. “Izinsiza zeHhovisi Eliyinhloko”. Igama elingenalutho lenza umugqa uhluleke.
budgets_planning.col_help_allocated_amount: Inombolo. Izimpawu zemali, izikhala nabahlukanisi bezinkulungwane bayasuswa, ngakho “R 1 850 000,00” no-“1850000” kokubili kuyasebenza. Noma yini engeyona inombolo yenza umugqa uhluleke.
budgets_planning.col_help_expenditure_type: Ibuyela ku-opex uma kungenalutho noma kungaziwa.
budgets_planning.col_help_category: Kumele kufane nelinye lamagama ezigaba angezansi. Igama elingafani lishiya isabelomali singenasigaba futhi liphakamise isexwayiso.
budgets_planning.col_help_scope_type: Ibuyela kokujwayelekile uma kungenalutho noma kungaziwa.
budgets_planning.col_help_scope_label: Umbhalo okhululekile oqamba umnyango, iphrojekthi noma indawo yezindleko, isb. “Ihhovisi Eliyinhloko”.
budgets_planning.col_help_currency: Ikhodi yezinhlamvu ezintathu njenge-ZAR. Noma yini enye iyaziwa futhi kusebenza okuzenzakalelayo kwenkampani.
budgets_planning.categories_hint: Upelo lufaniswa ngaphandle kokunaka onobumba abakhulu, kodwa igama kumele libe yilona kanye ngaphandle kwalokho.
budgets_planning.categories_none: Azikho izigaba okwamanje. Zengeze ngaphansi kwe-Lungiselela › Amasethingi, noma ushiye ikholomu yesigaba ingenalutho.

budgets_dashboard.no_rules_notice: Ayikho imithetho yezexwayiso ebekiwe, ngakho akukho okukuxwayisayo ngaphambi kokuba isabelomali siphele — kubikwa kuphela ukudlulela.

supplier_registration.documents_after: Ungawalayisha esangweni lakho lomhlinzeki uma leli fomu selithunyelwe.

preboarding.subtitle: Landelela abasebenzi abasha ngaphambi kokungena nasekungeneni

preboarding.no_plan_sub: Uhlelo lwangaphambi kokungena luzodalwa lapho umsebenzi omusha ebhaliswa.

onboarding_portal.intro: Kunezinto ezimbalwa okumele zilungiswe ngaphambi kosuku lwakho lokuqala.
onboarding_portal.documents_sub: Layisha esikudingayo. Ungashintsha ifayela uma sicela.
onboarding_portal.footer: Uma kukhona okungalungile lapha, phendula i-imeyili ekuthumele lolu xhumo.

onboarding_analytics.subtitle: Ukuthi abantu abasha bayangeniswa yini ngempela, nokuthi kuma kuphi
onboarding_analytics.ageing_sub: Umsebenzi owodwa obambeke inyanga ubaluleke kunamashumi amathathu asalele usuku
onboarding_analytics.department_sub: Lapho ongangenela khona — inani elilodwa lifihla umnyango ongaqedi
onboarding_analytics.provisioning_sub: Ukuthi ukulungiselelwa kufika ngaphambi komuntu yini

crm_reassign.move_activities_hint: Amakholi nemihlangano eqediwe ihlala kolowo owayenzayo.

payroll_milestones.description: Ukubuyekezwa kwesikhathi sokuvivinya, iminyaka nokuphela kwesikhuthazo sentela yokuqasha — kuzo zombili izinjini zeholo.

rules.title: Imithetho yamagxathu
rules.help: Khetha ukuthi yimaphi amagxathu adala isaziso. Iklayenti elinemithetho yalo lisebenzisa yona esikhundleni sokuzenzakalelayo, ngakho umthetho osusiwe lapha uhlala ususiwe.
rules.label: Igama
rules.delete_body: Umthetho wezinyanga ezingu-{months} uyeka ukudala izaziso ezintsha. Lezo esezidaliwe zigcinwa.

document_management.title: Amadokhumenti
document_management.subtitle: Indawo eyodwa yamadokhumenti enhlangano, kugcinwe zonke izinguqulo.
document_management.dropzone_label: Yehlisa amafayela lapha noma cindezela ukukhetha amafayela
document_management.drop_here: Yehlisa amafayela lapha, noma chofoza ukukhetha
document_management.drop_hint: Kuya kufika kumafayela angu-{count} ngesikhathi, {max} MB ngalinye
document_management.rejected_count: Kungalayishwa amafayela angu-{max} kuphela ngesikhathi esisodwa.
document_management.notes_hint: Amanothi angaphakathi. Awakhonjiswa kunoma ubani ngaphandle kwale moduli.
document_management.sensitivity_hint: Ukwenza kuyimfihlo kukhawulela ukuthi ngubani ongakubona. Ukubucayi ngokomthetho kukubeka ngaphansi kokubanjwa — ngeke kususwe lapho lokho kumisiwe.
document_management.search: Sesha — zama “umshwalense womhlinzeki ophela phakathi kwezinsuku ezingu-30”
document_management.held_cannot_delete: Kuphansi kokubanjwa ngokomthetho — ngeke kususwe kuze kususwe ukubanjwa.
document_management.versions_help: Ukushintsha ifayela kugcina leli dokhumenti nakho konke okukulo. Izinguqulo zangaphambili zihlala zifundeka.
document_management.history_help: Konke okwenzekile kuleli dokhumenti, kufaka phakathi ukuthi ngubani olivulile.
document_management.sensitivity_help: Ukushintsha noma yikuphi kwalokhu kuqoshwa negama lakho.
document_management.sensitivity_note_hint: Kungani kuphawulwe — kusiza lapho umuntu ebuza kamuva.
document_management.remove_help: Ukugcina kuyabuyiselwa. Ukususa kungahlehliswa kuze kube idokhumenti libhujiswe unomphela.
document_management.hold_explainer: Leli dokhumenti liphansi kokubanjwa ngokomthetho. Ngeke lisuswe lapho lokho kusendaweni.
document_management.archived_explainer: Leli dokhumenti ligcinwe. Lisafundeka futhi lingabuyiselwa.

settings_page.title: Izilungiselelo zamadokhumenti
settings_page.subtitle: Okungalayishwa lapha, ubukhulu obungakanani, nokuthi amadokhumenti aqanjwa kanjani.
settings_page.max_size_hint: Kusebenza kwifayela ngalinye, hhayi kuwo wonke ukulayisha.
settings_page.types_help: Uhlu lokuvumela. Noma yini engekho kulo iyenqatshwa.
settings_page.blocked_hint: Zisuswa ohlwini olivumelekile noma zikhona kulo.
settings_page.never_help: Lezi zenqatshwa noma ngabe kulungiselelwe kanjani. Isiphequluli noma iseva ingazisebenzisa, futhi umtapo wamadokhumenti awunasizathu sokwamukela okunye.
settings_page.categories_hint: Ukuthi idokhumenti liyini, ngokwehlukile kokuthi lifayiliwe kuphi. Izigaba ezakhelwe ngaphakathi zingaqanjwa kabusha noma zivalwe kodwa azisusiwe — imibiko nemithetho yokugcina ibhekisa kuzo.
settings_page.category_protected: Izigaba ezakhelwe ngaphakathi ngeke zisuswe. Kunalokho zivale.
settings_page.expiry_hint: Xwayisa abantu ngaphambi kokuthi idokhumenti liphele. Ukushanela kusebenza njalo ekuseni futhi kuthumela isikhumbuzo ngasinye kanye.
settings_page.expiry_days_hint: Cindezela u-enter emva kwenombolo ngayinye. U-0 usho ngosuku lokuphela uqobo.
settings_page.expiry_roles_hint: Umnikazi wedokhumenti uyaziswa njalo. Izindima, hhayi amagama, ukuze isikhumbuzo silandele noma ubani ophethe umsebenzi.
settings_page.retention_hint: Isikhathi amadokhumenti akulesi sigaba agcinwa ngaso. Shiya isikhathi singenalutho uma kungekho uhlelo — akukho okubhujiswa ngokuzenzakalela.
settings_page.retention_note_hint: Kuboniswa eceleni kolayini wokulahla, ukuze umbuyekezi abone ukuthi umthetho umelani.
settings_page.sharing_warning: Uma kuvuliwe, noma ubani onesixhumanisi angavula lelo dokhumenti ngaphandle kokungena. Isixhumanisi ngasinye siyaphelelwa yisikhathi, singahoxiswa, futhi siyaqoshwa.
settings_page.sharing_enabled: Vumela amadokhumenti ukuthi abelwane ngaphandle kwenhlangano
settings_page.share_max_days_hint: Umkhawulo waso sonke isixhumanisi. Ocela okude uthola lokhu.
settings_page.ai_warning: Uma kuvuliwe, okuqukethwe kwedokhumenti kuthunyelwa kumhlinzeki we-AI leli pulatifomu elihlelwe ngaye, futhi kubalwa esabelweni senyanga senkampani.
settings_page.ai_include_confidential_hint: Kuvaliwe ngokuzenzakalela. Yiwo amadokhumenti inhlangano engathandi ukuwanikeza insizakalo yangaphandle.
settings_page.watermark_default: Faka uphawu lwamanzi kumakhophi abelwana ngokuzenzakalela
settings_page.watermark_default_hint: Ukwabelana ngakunye kusengashintshwa. Uphawu lwamanzi lwenza ikhophi evuzile ilandeleke; alukuvimbeli.
settings_page.auto_delete_warning: Uma kuvuliwe, amadokhumenti avunywe umbuyekezi ukuthi alahlwe ayasuswa ngaphandle kokuqinisekiswa futhi. Ukususa lapha kuyabuyiseka — ukubhujiswa unomphela kuhlala kungumsebenzi womuntu.
settings_page.disposal_grace_days_hint: Isikhathi imvume elinda ngaso ngaphambi kokusetshenzwa, ukuze iphutha libanjwe.
settings_page.automation_hint: Lokho lesi sigaba esikwenzayo ngokwaso uma izinsuku ezingenhla sezidlulile.
settings_page.auto_delete_hint: Kudinga nesilungiselelo senkampani yonke. Amadokhumenti abanjwe ngokomthetho awathintwa neze.
settings_page.categories_delete_consequence: Only possible while nothing is filed under it.
settings_page.category_fields_hint: Lokho lolu hlobo lwedokhumenti olukuphethe ngaphandle kokujwayelekile. Isivumelwano sidinga umuntu esivumelwana naye; irisidi ayidingi lutho.
settings_page.category_workflow_hint: Ukuze "izinqubomgomo ziya kwabezomthetho" kube yisici sezinqubomgomo esikhundleni sokukhunjulwa ekulayisheni ngakunye.
settings_page.numbering_next_hint: Beka lokhu ukuze uqhubeke ususelela kuspredishithi kunokuqala futhi ku-1.
settings_page.numbering_pattern_hint: Izibambeli: {YYYY} {YY} {MM} kanye ne-#### yolandelelano. Shiya kungenalutho ukuze usebenzise ukunikeza izinombolo kwenkampani.
settings_page.watermark_previews_hint: Ukufunda kuphela kuvimba ukulanda kodwa akwenzi lutho ngesithombe sesikrini. Uphawu olusho ukuthi ubani obebuka yikona kuphela okwenzayo.
settings_page.downloads_days_hint: Isikhathi umuntu agcina ngaso ikhophi ayivunyelwe.
settings_page.lock_hours_hint: Ngemva kwalokhu idokhumenti izivula, ukuze kungabikho ovinjelwe umuntu osekhefini.

document_management.holds_release_warning: Uma ukubamba kokugcina kususwa, leli dokhumenti lingabuye lisuswe libhujiswe. Irekhodi lokuthi lalibanjiwe ligcinwa.

document_management.ai_quota: Isabelo se-AI sanyanga zonke sale nkampani siphelile.
document_management.ai_failed: Umsizi akufinyelelekanga kuye. Zama futhi maduze.
document_management.share_internal_none: Alikho okwabelwane nabo ngaphandle kokufinyelela okujwayelekile kwefolda.
document_management.share_internal_hint: Lokhu kuvula idokhumenti kumuntu ongakwazi ukulibona ngenye indlela. Akushintshi lutho ngalokho abanye abakubonayo.
document_management.activity_recent: Izinsuku ezingu-{days} ezedlule. Sebenzisa izinsuku ukubuka emuva kakhulu.
document_management.extraction_no_text_layer: Lokhu kubukeka njengesiskeni. Okuqukethwe akukwazi ukusesheshwa noma kufinyezwe ngaphandle uma kudlulisiwe kwi-OCR.
document_management.extraction_ocr_unavailable: Leli dokhumenti lidinga i-OCR ukuze lifundeke, futhi ayikho injini ye-OCR efakwe kule seva.
document_management.extraction_failed: Okuqukethwe kwaleli dokhumenti akukwazanga ukufundwa. Ukusesha ngeke kuthole lutho ngaphakathi kulo.
document_management.ai_fields_hint: Ifundwe imodeli embhalweni wedokhumenti. Maka okulungile — akukho okugcinwayo ngaphambi kwalokho.
document_management.share_watermark_hint: Ifaka umamukeli nosuku kuwo wonke amakhasi. Akulona uhlelo lokuphepha — kwenza ikhophi evuzile ilandeleke.
document_management.record_upload_hint: Ligcinwa kumtapo wamadokhumenti futhi lixhunywe kule rekhodi, ukuze litholakale ngazo zombili izindlela.
document_management.record_title_hint: Shiya kungenalutho ukuze kusetshenziswe igama lefayela
document_management.record_expiry_hint: Faka lokhu bese uhlelo luzoxhumana ngokuvuselelwa
document_management.storage_subtitle: Okusebenzisa isikhala, namafayela okumele aqalwe ngawo

document_management.view_archived_hint: Kususiwe endleleni kodwa kusaseshekha, futhi kungabuyiselwa noma nini
document_management.view_confidential_hint: Amadokhumenti amakwe njengemfihlo, noma agcinwe kufolda eyimfihlo
document_management.view_unreadable_hint: Iziskeni namafayela okuqukethwe kwawo okungakwazanga ukufundwa
document_management.access_hint: Umuntu ukuthumele lesi sixhumanisi, kodwa alikabelwana nawe. Ungacela ukufinyelela.
document_management.access_already: Isicelo sakho sithunyelwe. Uzokwazi ukuvula idokhumenti uma sesigunyaziwe.
document_management.access_requests_subtitle: Abantu abacela ukufinyelela idokhumenti noma ifolda
document_management.access_folder_note: Lokhu kunika amadokhumenti akule folda manje. Noma yini engezwa kamuva iyisinqumo esisha.
document_management.recycle_subtitle: Amadokhumenti asusiwe ahlala lapha izinsuku ezingu-{days} futhi angabuyiselwa noma nini
document_management.recycle_purge_warning: Lokhu kubhubhisa idokhumenti nazo zonke izinguqulo zalo. Irekhodi lokuthi lalikhona futhi labhujiswa ligcinwa, kodwa ifayela ngeke libuyiseleke.
document_management.recycle_empty_counts: Amadokhumenti angu-{purgeable} asedlulile isikhathi sawo. Angu-{held} abanjwe ngokomthetho ngeke athintwe.
document_management.recycle_empty_everything_hint: Kuvaliwe ngokuzenzakalela. Ukuthulula ngokujwayelekile kusho konke okudlulile isikhathi, hhayi lokho umuntu akususe namuhla ekuseni.
document_management.groups_subtitle: Nika ukufinyelela iqembu labantu kunohlu lwamagama
document_management.groups_expires_hint: Ngokuzikhethela. Uma liphela, konke ukufinyelela elikunikile kuphela nalo.
document_management.groups_folders_hint: Iqoqo elilodwa lezimvume kuwo wonke amafolda owakhethayo. Yilokho okwenza kube yisinqumo esisodwa.
document_management.groups_access_expires_hint: Ngokuzikhethela. Ukufinyelela okunosuku akudingi ukukhunjulwa bese kuhoxiswa.
document_management.downloads_read_only_hint: Le dokhumenti ingafundwa lapha kodwa ayilandeki.
document_management.downloads_read_only_folder: Le fayela ingeyokufunda kuphela, ngakho amakhophi alokho okugcinwe kuyo awuphumi.
document_management.access_map_subtitle: Ubani ongafinyelela kuphi, ngani, nokuphelayo ngokwakho.
document_management.access_map_ending_hint: Inhloso yokufinyelela kwesikhashana ukuthi akekho okumele akukhumbule. Kodwa kumele kube khona ongakubona.
document_management.access_map_checked_out_hint: Kukhona osebenza kuwo. Akekho omunye ongalayisha inguqulo entsha kuze kuqedwe.
document_management.requests_what_hint: Sho into, hhayi ifayela — "Ikhophi ka-ID egunyaziwe" kunokuthi "iskena".
document_management.checklists_no_templates: Azikho izinhlobo zamaphakethe ezisethiwe. Uhlobo lwephakethe uhlu njengomthetho — "iphakethe lomsebenzi omusha yila madokhumenti ayisikhombisa".
document_management.checklists_no_folder: Alikho ifayela elikhethiwe, ngakho akukho okuzozimaka.
document_management.checklists_expects_anything: Akukho okusethiwe ukufanisa — lokhu kumakwa ngesandla
document_management.checklists_chase_hint: Yonke into esalindile iba isicelo, ngesenzo esisodwa. Ukucela ngayinye kulapho eyokugcina ikhohlakala khona.
document_management.checklists_subject_hint: Umuntu, umhlinzeki, ithenda — noma yini leli phakethe elimayelana nayo.
document_management.checklists_folder_hint: Lapho amadokhumenti ahlala khona. Izinto zizimaka njengoba amadokhumenti afanayo egcinwa lapha.
document_management.checklists_template_hint: Qamba iphakethe, hhayi icala — "Iphakethe lomsebenzi omusha", hhayi "uThandi".
document_management.checklists_category_hint: Into enesigaba izimaka uma idokhumenti yaleso sigaba igcinwa efayeleni. Engenaso ingamakwa ngesandla kuphela.
document_management.superseded_banner: Le akuyona idokhumenti esebenzayo. Yashintshwa ngo-{date}.
document_management.share_require_code_hint: Iphasiwedi ihamba ku-imeyili efanayo nesixhumanisi. Ikhodi ethunyelwe kulelo kheli ifakazela ukuthi ovulayo unebhokisi lemeyili.
document_management.share_require_code_needs_email: Faka ikheli le-imeyili lomamukeli ukuze usebenzise lokhu.
document_management.shared_code_hint: Singathumela ikhodi ku-{email} ukuqinisekisa ukuthi nguwe.
document_management.shared_code_sent_hint: Ikhodi ithunyelwe ku-{email}. Ihlala imizuzu eyishumi nanhlanu.
document_management.quotas_subtitle: Ngaphansi kwaleyo yenkampani. Umnyango owodwa ogcwalisa yonke imvume umisa wonke umuntu, yonke indawo.
document_management.quotas_none: Ayikho imikhawulo ebekiwe. Kusebenza kuphela imvume yenkampani.
document_management.quotas_warn_hint: Ukwenqatshelwa ngaphandle kwesixwayiso kufana nokuphuka kwesistimu.
document_management.access_map_refusals_hint: Ukwenqatshelwa okukodwa isixhumanisi esidala. Okuyisishiyagalolunye ngesonto kuyingxoxo.
document_management.access_map_downloads_hint: Ukulanda kuyisikhathi lapho idokhumenti ingasalawulwa yile sistimu.
document_management.access_map_heavily_granted_hint: Noma bayakudinga, noma kunqwabelene ngesisodwa ngesikhathi. Inombolo ukuphela kwendlela yokwazi.
document_management.shortcuts_hint: Indawo yesibili yokuthola le dokhumenti — hhayi ikhophi yesibili yayo.
document_management.shortcuts_dialog_hint: Ihlala iyidokhumenti eyodwa. Inguqulo entsha ivela yonke indawo lapho igcinwe khona, futhi izimvume zayo azishintshi.
document_management.access_ask_hint: Khetha konke okudingayo ngasikhathi sinye. Ukucela ngakunye kulapho okokugcina kukhohlakala khona.
document_management.access_ask_reason_hint: Ophendulayo kumele anqume okuthile, futhi "asikho isizathu esinikeziwe" kucishe kube ukwenqaba.
document_management.checklists_people_hint: Khetha oyedwa noma abaningi — kuqalwa iphakethe kumuntu ngamunye.
document_management.perm_manage_explainer: Somebody who administers a folder decides who else may use it. They cannot move it, delete it, or reach any other folder.
document_management.folder_permissions_subtitle: A group survives somebody joining or leaving. A list of names has to be revisited every time either happens.
document_management.folder_permissions_none: Nobody has been given this folder. Whether it is open depends on the folder's own kind.
document_management.folder_permissions_save_body: This replaces every rule on {name} with what is on screen.
document_management.folder_permissions_save_consequence: Anybody whose row you removed loses access as soon as this is saved.
document_management.groups_delete_consequence: Everyone in it loses every folder the group opened. The folders and their documents are untouched.
document_management.groups_remove_member_title: Take this person out of the group?
document_management.groups_remove_member_consequence: They lose every folder this group opens, unless something else gives it to them.
document_management.groups_revoke_folder_title: Take this folder off the group?
document_management.groups_revoke_folder_consequence: Everyone in the group loses it, unless something else gives it to them.
document_management.documents_delete_consequence: It goes to the recycle bin and can be restored until the bin is emptied.
document_management.templates_delete_consequence: Documents already generated from it are not affected.
document_management.quotas_remove_consequence: Storage there becomes unlimited again, up to the company's own allowance.
document_management.share_revoke_internal_body: {who} would no longer see this document.
document_management.share_revoke_internal_consequence: Unless they can reach it another way — through a folder, a role or a group.
document_management.share_revoke_link_consequence: It stops working immediately, including for anybody it was forwarded to.
document_management.access_map_revoke_body: {who} would lose it now rather than when it was due to end.
document_management.access_map_revoke_consequence: It cannot be undone from here — it would have to be granted again.
document_management.archive_contents_help: Vula ifayela elilodwa ngaphandle kokulanda yonke i-akhayivu.
document_management.archive_unreadable: Le akhayivu ayikwazanga ukuvulwa. Kungenzeka ilimele noma ivikelwe ngephasiwedi.
document_management.preview_failed: Leli fayela alikwazanga ukuboniswa lapha. Lilande esikhundleni salokho.

employee_reputation_dashboard.title: Ukuqashwa Kwedumela Nengozi Yomsebenzi
employee_reputation_dashboard.subtitle: Ukuqashwa okugunyaziwe kolwazi LOMPHAKATHI ezindabeni, enkantolo, kumlawuli, ezijezisweni, kwezenhlalo nakwimithombo yobungcweti — kubukezwa ngumuntu.
employee_reputation_dashboard.disclaimer_body: Le mojuli iveza ulwazi LOMPHAKATHI olungase lufaneleke kanye nomongo, ukuzethemba nomsuka ukuze umuntu alubuyekeze. Alwenzi futhi alutusi imiphumela yokuqasha, ukuxosha noma yesiyalo. Ukufana kwegama akuwona ubufakazi bobunikazi. Sebenzisa kuphela ngemvume nangokuhambisana nomthetho wemfihlo nowabasebenzi.
employee_reputation_dashboard.by_domain_hint: Izimpawu zomphakathi ezihlanganiswe ngendawo. Izindawo eziqondiswe engozini zingezokubuyekezwa kuphela, hhayi iziphetho.

employee_reputation_settings.title: Izilungiselelo zokuqashwa kwedumela nengozi
employee_reputation_settings.subtitle: Lungiselela ukuqashwa okugunyaziwe okusebenzisa ulwazi lomphakathi kuphela. Konke okutholakele kubukezwa ngumuntu.
employee_reputation_settings.compliance_body: Vula ukuqashwa kuphela lapho ugunyaziwe futhi kuhambisana nomthetho wemfihlo nowabasebenzi. Kuqashwa ulwazi LOMPHAKATHI kuphela — hhayi ama-akhawunti angasese. Okutholakele kuyachazeka, kunamaphuzu okuzethemba nomsuka, kuhlonipha isikhathi sokugcina esingezansi, kulawulwa ukufinyelela futhi kuhlolwa ngokugcwele, futhi akulokothi kusetshenziselwe izinqumo zomsebenzi ezizenzakalelayo.
employee_reputation_settings.consent_required: Dinga imvume / ugunyazo lomsebenzi ngaphambi kokuqashwa
employee_reputation_settings.consent_hint: Kuqashwa ulwazi lomphakathi kuphela — hhayi ama-akhawunti angasese. Ukubuyekezwa ngumuntu kuyadingeka ngaphambi kwanoma yisiphi isenzo.
employee_reputation_settings.negative_spike: Xwayisa ngomuzwa omubi ku- noma ngaphansi kwa-
employee_reputation_settings.auto_reports: Khiqiza ngokuzenzakalela imibiko yophenyo lwe-AI (yokubuyekezwa ngumuntu) ngezexwayiso ezinkulu

recruitment_screening_show.disclaimer_title: Okokubuyekezwa ngumuntu — akusona isinqumo sokuqasha esizenzakalelayo
recruitment_screening_show.disclaimer_body: Lezi zinkomba ezikhiqizwe yi-AI ziwusizo lokunquma kuphela futhi akumele neze ziqhube ukuqasha noma ukwenqaba okuzenzakalelayo. Ukufana kwegama akuwona ubufakazi bobunikazi. Buyekeza ubufakazi ngokwakho unikeze umfakisicelo ithuba lokunikeza umongo ngaphambi kokuphetha.

recruitment_screening_show.empty_body: Akukho ukuhlungwa kwe-AI okwenziwe kulo mfakisicelo. Qalisa okukodwa ukuze kuvele izinkomba zobungcweti zomphakathi zokubuyekezwa.
recruitment_screening_show.empty_no_consent: Lo mfakisicelo akakunikanga imvume yokucutshungulwa kwe-AI, ngakho ukuhlungwa akukwazi ukwenziwa.
recruitment_screening_show.status_skipped_no_consent: Ukuhlungwa kweqiwe ngoba umfakisicelo akakunikanga imvume yokucutshungulwa kwe-AI.
recruitment_screening_show.questions_hint: Imibuzo engathathi hlangothi evumela umfakisicelo ukuba anikeze owakhe umongo.
recruitment_screening_show.misidentification_caveat: Ukungachazeki kahle okungenzeka: ezinye izinto ezitholakele zingaba ngezomunye umuntu onegama elifanayo. Qinisekisa ubunikazi ngaphambi kokuthembela kulokhu okutholakele.

dashboard.readiness_todo: Kwenze lokhu ngokulandelana — ngasinye siyadingeka ngaphambi kokuthi ama-oda ahlelwe.
dashboard.step_work_centres_hint: Isikhungo esingenazinga asikwazi ukuhlelwa noma kubalwe izindleko ngaso
dashboard.step_units_hint: Kuyadingeka ngaphambi kokuthi noma iyiphi iresiphi isho ubuningi
dashboard.step_boms_hint: Umkhiqizo ongenayo iresiphi egunyaziwe awukwazi ukuodwa
dashboard.no_bom_hint: I-oda lokukhiqiza alikwazi ukuvuselwa lena kuze kugunyazwe uhlu lwezinto zokwakha.

products.title: Imikhiqizo
products.subtitle: Incazelo yobunjiniyela yakho konke okwenzayo, okuthengayo nokusebenzisayo
products.add_hint: Umkhiqizo unweba into yesitoko ekhona. Ikhodi, igama nezindleko kuhlala entweni yesitoko.
products.name: Igama
products.none_hint: Engeza into yesitoko kurejista yobunjiniyela ukuze uqale.

product.bought_no_recipe: Le yinto ethengwe ngaphandle, ngakho ayinayo iresiphi.
product.no_recipes: Ayikho iresiphi esibhaliwe yalo mkhiqizo okwamanje.
product.external_reference_hint: Inombolo yomdwebo wekhasimende, yomdwebo ogcinwe kwenye indawo
product.no_documents: Ayikho imidwebo, imiyalelo noma imininingwane eqondile ebhaliwe.
product.register_hint: Ukuthi ifayela ngalinye lingelani. Khomba okufakiwe efayeleni elifakwe ngenhla, noma kunkomba egcinwe kwenye indawo.
product.no_attributes: Azikho izici. Engeza noma yisiphi isichazi esisetshenziswa yifekthri yakho — ukuqedwa, ubulukhuni, ibanga lentambo.

boms.title: Izinhlu zezinto zokwakha
boms.subtitle: Amaresiphi, izinguqulo nokugunyazwa
boms.new_hint: Imikhiqizo ephelile, okuphakathi nezingxenye ezihlanganisiwe kuphela ezingaba neresiphi. Impahla eluhlaza iyathengwa, ayenziwa.
boms.none_hint: Bhala uhlaka lweresiphi kusuka emkhiqizweni ukuze uqale.

bom.name: Igama
bom.batch_size_hint: Ukulahlekelwa kwenqubo nokusetha kukhokhwa kanye ngeqoqo ngalinye
bom.alternate_group_hint: Imigqa esebenzisa iqembu elifanayo iyisinqumo esisodwa, hhayi izimfuneko eziningana
bom.discard_body: Lolu hlaka nezingxenye zalo kuzosuswa. Izinguqulo ezigunyaziwe azithinteki neze.
bom.locked_approved: Le nguqulo igunyaziwe futhi ayikwazi ukuhlelwa. Yibuyekeze ukuze ushintshe iresiphi — eyokuqala ihlala injalo ncamashi, futhi ama-oda asekhululiwe aqhubeka eyisebenzisa.
bom.locked_superseded: Le nguqulo ithathelwe isikhundla futhi igcinwa njengerekhodi. Ithathelwe isikhundla ngu-
bom.locked_obsolete: Le nguqulo iyekiwe futhi ngeke isetshenziswe kunoma iyiphi i-oda elisha.

where_used.title: Lapho kusetshenziswa khona
where_used.subtitle: Yimaphi amaresiphi lapho into ivela khona — buza ngaphambi kokuthi uyishintshe noma uyiyeke
where_used.choose: Khetha into ukuze ubone yonke iresiphi eyisebenzisayo.
where_used.none: Le nto ayisetshenziswa kunoma iyiphi iresiphi esebenzayo.

factories.title: Amafekthri
factories.subtitle: Amasayithi, iminyango nemigqa yokukhiqiza
factories.concepts: Ifekthri, inqolobane, umugqa wokukhiqiza nesikhungo somsebenzi yizinto ezihlukene. Ifekthri inekhalenda nohlobo lwemali; inqolobane igcina isitoko; umugqa uyindlela edabula efekthri; isikhungo somsebenzi sinomthamo nezindleko ngehora.
factories.none_hint: Dala isayithi lakho lokuqala ukuze uqale ukulungisa izikhungo zomsebenzi namashifu.
factories.warehouse_hint: Lapho isitoko sale fekthri sifika khona. Izinqolobane ziphathwa kwezeziMali.
factories.assign_hint: Umuntu owabelwe efekthri uvalelwe kuyo. Akakwazi ukubona ukulungiswa kwenye ifekthri, izikhungo zomsebenzi noma amashifu ngaphandle uma ebelwe nalapho.
factories.whole_factory_hint: Shiya kungenalutho ukuze unikeze ifekthri yonke, noma ukhethe umnyango owodwa ukuze ubavalele ezikhungweni zawo zomsebenzi.
factories.unrestricted: Akekho owabelwe lapha, ngakho wonke umuntu onokufinyelela kule moduli angayibona le fekthri. Abela abantu ukuze ubavalele kumafekthri abawaphethe.
factories.all_factories_note: Indima yakho ingabona wonke amafekthri, ngakho lokhu kwabelwa akushintshi lokho okubonayo.

setup.remove_factory_deactivates: I-{name} inezikhungo zomsebenzi ezinomlando wokukhiqiza, ngakho izokwenziwa ingasebenzi kunokuba isuswe.

workcentres.title: Izikhungo zomsebenzi
workcentres.subtitle: Umthamo, amazinga ezindleko, iziteshi zokusebenza nemishini
workcentres.none_hint: Dala ifekthri kuqala, bese wengeza izindawo lapho imisebenzi yenzeka khona.
workcentres.unrated: Izikhungo zomsebenzi ezingu-{n} azinawo umthamo noma izinga lezindleko, ngakho azikwazi ukuhlelwa noma kubalwe izindleko ngazo.
workcentres.machine_hint: Imishini ivela kurejista yezimpahla, ngakho izinombolo ze-serial nomlando wokunakekela kuhlala endaweni eyodwa.

shifts.title: Amashifu nokuvalwa
shifts.subtitle: Amaphethini okusebenza, imithetho ye-ovathayimi nokuma okuhleliwe
shifts.overnight_hint: Le shifu iphela ngaphambi kokuthi iqale. Uma iqhubeka ubusuku bonke, vula ethi "Iphela ngosuku olulandelayo".
shifts.line_hint: Shiya kungenalutho uma ifekthri yonke ima
shifts.calendar_hint: Lokho ifekthri engakwenza ngempela usuku ngalunye: amashifu, kususwe amaholide omphakathi, kususwe ukuvalwa.
shifts.calendar_none: Dala ifekthri neshifu ukuze ubone ikhalenda yayo yokusebenza.

units.title: Amayunithi okulinganisa
units.subtitle: Amayunithi, ubukhulu nokuguqulwa okuvumelekile
units.rule: Amayunithi aguquka ngokukhululekile ngaphakathi kobukhulu obubodwa (kg kuya ku-g). Phakathi kobukhulu obuhlukene akwenzeki — amakhilogremu kuya kumalitha kuncike entweni, nephakethe lincike entweni — ngakho lokho kubhalwa ngento ngayinye ngezansi.
units.conversions_hint: Ubudlelwano obungaguquki bento eyodwa — iphakethe leshumi nambili, isigubhu samalitha angu-210
units.container_hint: Izitsha azinawo usayizi wazo. Ukuthi mangaki amayunithi asephakethe kuncike entweni, ngakho kubhalwa ngento ngayinye ngezansi.

numbering.title: Ukunikezwa kwezinombolo zamadokhumenti
numbering.subtitle: Ukulandelana kwezinombolo zama-oda okukhiqiza, imisebenzi namadokhumenti
numbering.scope_hint: Shiya kungenalutho ukuze kube ukulandelana kwenkampani yonke
numbering.none_hint: Faka amayunithi ajwayelekile nokulandelana kusuka ekhasini lamaYunithi.

policies.title: Izinqubomgomo nokugunyazwa
policies.subtitle: Ukubekezelelwa, imithetho yokukhiqiza nemikhawulo yokugunyaza
policies.blank_hint: Shiya ukubekezelelwa kungenalutho ukuze kube "akukho okulungisiwe". Lokho kwehlukile ku-0%, okusho ukuthi wonke umehluko kumele uchazwe.
policies.require_bom_approval: Izinhlu zezinto zokwakha zidinga ukugunyazwa ngomunye umuntu ongeyena owalubhala
policies.allow_over_issue: Vumela ukukhipha okungaphezu kwalokho okudingwa yi-oda
policies.limits_hint: Ama-oda okukhiqiza angaphezu kwenani elithile adinga ogunyazayo ophezulu. Ibhendi ngayinye ihlanganisa uhla lwamanani ama-oda; ndawonye kufanele zihlanganise wonke amanani.
policies.blank_ceiling: Shiya kungenalutho ukuze kube "nakho konke okungaphezulu"
policies.limits_applies: Kuhlolwa uma i-oda lokukhiqiza ligunyazwa, kusetshenziswa inani elilinganiselwe le-oda.
policies.approver_hint: Abantu abanale mvume kuphela abangagunyaza ama-oda akule bhendi
policies.holders: Umuntu ongu-{n} unayo | Abantu abangu-{n} banayo
policies.no_holders: Akekho onayo okwamanje — ama-oda akule bhendi ngeke akwazi ukugunyazwa
policies.factory_hint: Amabhendi efekthri ngokwayo asetshenziswa ngaphambi kwalawo enkampani yonke
policies.escalate_hint: Khumbuza umphathi wogunyazayo uma kulinda isikhathi esingaka
policies.summary: Ama-oda okukhiqiza abiza {from} {to} {where} adinga ukugunyazwa ngumuntu ongakwazi “{who}”.

categories.title: Izigaba zemikhiqizo
categories.hint: Uhlu okukhethwa kulo ohlwini lwezigaba. Isigaba esisetshenziswayo siyayekwa kunokuba sisuswe, ngakho imikhiqizo efakwe ngaphansi kwaso iyaqhubeka nayo.
categories.name: Isigaba esisha
categories.none_yet: Azikho izigaba okwamanje. Engeza esisodwa ukuze uqale.

routings.title: Izindlela zokukhiqiza
routings.subtitle: Ukuthi umkhiqizo ngamunye uhamba kanjani efekthri: imisebenzi, izikhungo zomsebenzi, izikhathi namasango
routings.none_hint: Bhala uhlaka lwendlela yokukhiqiza yomkhiqizo ukuze uqale.

routing.operations_hint: Ngokulandelana. Umsebenzi awukwazi ukuqedwa kuze kube yileyo eyimpoqo engaphambi kwawo, namasango ayo, isiphumelele.
routing.alt_run_hint: Shiya kungenalutho ukuze kusetshenziswe isikhathi sokusebenza somsebenzi uqobo
routing.machine_type_hint: Esikhundleni sesikhungo somsebenzi: noma yisiphi isikhungo esinalolu hlobo lomshini
routing.parallel_hint: Imisebenzi enesiqembu esifanayo yenzeka ngesikhathi esisodwa
routing.locked_approved: Le ndlela yokukhiqiza igunyaziwe futhi ayikwazi ukuhlelwa. Yibuyekeze ukuze ushintshe indlela umkhiqizo owenziwa ngayo — ama-oda asekhululiwe aqhubeka esebenzisa le nguqulo.
routing.discard_body: Lolu hlaka lwendlela yokukhiqiza nemisebenzi yalo kuzosuswa. Izinguqulo ezigunyaziwe azithinteki neze.
routing.estimate_hint: Lokho okudingwa ukwenza ubuningi obuthile, kubalwe ngekhalenda yefekthri.

orders.title: Ama-oda okukhiqiza
orders.subtitle: Wonke ama-oda, kusukela ohlakeni kuze kuvalwe
orders.new_hint: Kuboshelwe ku-BOM nendlela yokukhiqiza esebenzayo ngosuku lokuqala
orders.none_hint: Vusa elilodwa kusuka emkhiqizweni onohlu lwezinto zokwakha olugunyaziwe.
orders.start_hint: Kunquma ukuthi yiziphi izinguqulo ze-BOM nendlela yokukhiqiza i-oda elizisebenzisayo
orders.material_warehouse_hint: Lapho izinto zikhishwa khona; inqolobane yokukhiqiziwe uma kungenalutho
orders.allow_below_min_batch: Vumela ubuningi obungaphansi kweqoqo elincane lendlela yokukhiqiza
orders.locked_closed: Leli oda livaliwe. Amarekhodi alo akhiyiwe; ukulungiswa kwenziwa njengokulungisa.
orders.checks_hint: Lokho ukugunyaza okuqinisekisayo, njengoba kunjalo manje
orders.checks_clear: Izinto, i-BOM, indlela yokukhiqiza nomthamo konke kuhlelekile.
orders.no_operations: Leli oda alinayo imisebenzi yendlela yokukhiqiza.
orders.receive_output_hint: Kungena esitokweni ngezindleko ezijwayelekile zezinto; kungena ekuhlukaniseni uma ifekthri ihlola ngaphambi kokugcinwa
orders.output_hint: Okukhiqiziwe nokulahlekelwa kubhalwa yindawo yokusebenzela ngesikhathi i-oda liqhubeka.
orders.approve_override_hint: Izinto ziyashoda noma umthamo weqiwe. Ukugunyaza noma kunjalo kubhalwa njengokuhlukile nesizathu sakho.
orders.rescale_hint: Ubuningi obusha bulinganisa kabusha izinto, imisebenzi nesilinganiso
orders.lot_hint: Shiya kungenalutho ukuze kukhethwe okuphelelwa yisikhathi kuqala kuqala
orders.over_issue: Lokhu kungaphezu kwalokho i-oda elisakudingayo. Ukukhipha ngokweqile kudinga ukweqa okugunyaziwe nesizathu ngaphandle uma ifekthri ikuvumela.
orders.lot_number_hint: Kuzenzakalela kube yinombolo ye-oda ({n}) yomkhiqizo olandelelwa nge-lot
orders.quality_hold: Ukukhiqiza kumisiwe kuze kube ikhwalithi inquma nge-{list}.

quality.inspections_subtitle: Konke ukuhlola okusafanele kubhalwe noma kunqunywe, nalokho osekuvaliwe
quality.receive_hint: Kungena ekuhlukaniseni, kuvulwe ukuhlola kwakho okungenayo
quality.hold_hint: Kumisa isitoko esisebenzisekayo; akukho okungasikhipha noma kusithumele kuze kube sekunqunyiwe
quality.supplier_hint: Kuyazikhethela: uhlelo lwezinto zalo mhlinzeki kuphela

disposition_hint.CONDITIONAL_ACCEPT: Kuyasisebenzisa naphezu kokutholakele. Kubhalwa njengemvumelwano nesizathu sakho.
disposition_hint.REJECT: Kuhambisa isitoko esimisiwe siye kokwenqatshiwe; ngeke siphinde sikhishwe noma sithunyelwe.
disposition_hint.RETURN_TO_SUPPLIER: Kwenqaba isitoko ngokomhlinzeki ne-oda lakhe lokuthenga.
disposition_hint.REWORK: Kubuyisela umsebenzi emuva; uphinde uhlolwe ngemuva kwalokho.

quality.held_alert: {qty} kumisiwe ku-{status} kuze kunqunywe ngalokhu kuhlola.
quality.blocking_alert: Lokhu kuhlola okwehlulekile kumisa ukukhiqiza kwi-oda lakho kuze kube umuntu ogunyaziwe unquma ukuthi kwenzekani ngomsebenzi.
quality.record_hint_plan: Ukuhlola ngakunye kwahlulelwa ngokuzenzakalela ngokwemikhawulo yakho. Isampula elingu-{n} ekuhloleni ngakunye.
quality.record_hint_adhoc: Alukho uhlelo olusebenzayo, ngakho qamba ukuhlola ngakunye bese ukwahlulela.
quality.decide_hint: Isinqumo kuphela esihambisa isitoko noma esivumela ukukhiqiza kuqhubeke.
quality.certificate_required: Lolu hlelo ludinga isitifiketi esifakwe ngezansi ngaphambi kokuthi isitoko sikhululwe.
quality.plans_subtitle: Yini ehlolwayo, ngayiphi imikhawulo, nokuthi ukwehluleka kumisa ini
quality.checks_hint: Isilinganiso esinemikhawulo, noma isici sokudlula/ukwehluleka. Ukuhlola kugcina ikhophi yemikhawulo okwabhalwa ngokuyo.
quality.every_qty_hint: Ukuhlola okukodwa ngemuva kokuqedwa kwamayunithi angaka
quality.operation_hint: Kungenalutho: noma yiliphi iphuzu lokuhlola lalo mkhiqizo
quality.critical_hint: Kubucayi: ukwehluleka lapha kuvusa ukungahambisani okukhulu
quality.ncrs_subtitle: Yini engahambanga kahle, kungani, nokuthi yini ekuvimbela ukuthi kuphinde kwenzeke
quality.search_ncrs: Sesha inombolo, ikhodi yokungapheleli noma umbhalo
quality.repeat_defects_hint: Amakhodi okungapheleli avuswe izikhathi ezingaphezu kwesisodwa ngonyaka odlule
quality.not_effective: Ukuqinisekisa kokugcina kuthole ukuthi isenzo asisebenzi. {notes}
quality.investigation_hint: Kuvimbele, uthole imbangela eyisisekelo, bese wenza okuthile ngayo
quality.actions_hint: Ukuvimbela ukusabalala, ukulungisa nokuvimbela, ngasinye sinomnikazi nosuku lokugcina
quality.repeats_hint: Ikhodi yokungapheleli efanayo kule nto noma evela kulo mhlinzeki ngonyaka odlule
quality.no_code: Nika i-NCR ikhodi yokungapheleli ukuze kubalwe okuphindiwe.
quality.verify_hint: I-NCR enkulu noma ebucayi iqinisekiswa ngumuntu ongenzanga nesisodwa sezenzo zayo.

floor.title: Indawo yokusebenzela
floor.scan: Skena ikhadi lomsebenzi, i-oda noma i-lot
floor.offline: Ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi: ukuthepha kuyagcinwa futhi kuthunyelwe kamuva
floor.pause_hint: Nikeza isizathu uma umsebenzi umile ngoba kukhona okungahambanga kahle; kubhalwa njengesikhathi sokuma.
floor.time_measured: Isikhathi somshini nesabasebenzi sithathwa esikhathini lo msebenzi owenziwe ngaso.
floor.queued: Akukho ukuxhumana: kulondoloziwe, kuzothunyelwa uma inethiwekhi isibuyile.
floor.downtime_subtitle: Konke ukuma, ngesikhungo somsebenzi nangesizathu, nokuthi kubize imizuzu emingakanani
